title: Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents
title_zh: 位置、角色还是标签？大语言模型智能体中指令冲突的受控研究

paragraphs.en: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First , we build WhoWins , 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second , we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66% , and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message , in every model-mode. Third , we test whether pairs forecast larger conflicts; forecasts improve in every model-mode once they know where the task line is. Finally , by our keyword patterns at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge a conflict.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体接收来自操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和已保存记忆的指令，而这些指令常常相互冲突。 指令层级的基准测试询问的是排名更高的来源是否会胜出，但一个来源会同时设定位置、角色和标签。 首先，我们构建了WhoWins，包含1,080个经代码评分的场景，涵盖五种任务类型，每个场景最多包含五条互斥的指令，以及七个控制实验，这些实验仅改变指令的传递方式。 其次，我们研究了14个开放权重模型（0.6B到122B，关闭和开启思考模式），共1,887,356条经评分的回复，并在留出场景上检验主要发现。 在同一条消息内，两条冲突行中排在前面的以72.42%到94.66%的比例胜出，而跨消息时其保持率为22.95%到62.65%。 在系统（或开发者）消息中最先发送的策略，在每个Qwen模型中都会在与后续行的冲突中落败居多，但当其生效时，在gpt-oss上则胜出居多。 在工具和文件写入任务中，它比同样的文本作为带标签的用户消息最先发送时胜出频率更低，在所有模型-模式组合中均是如此。 第三，我们测试成对比较能否预测更大规模的冲突；一旦知道任务行所在位置，预测在所有模型-模式组合中都会改善。 最后，根据我们的关键词模式，在已判定的成对比较回复中，最多只有2.92%会标记或回避冲突。

paragraphs.en: An LLM agent reads instructions from several places in one conversation: the operator’s system prompt, a configuration file in the repository, the user, the output of a tool it called, and notes it saved in an earlier session. These instructions often disagree, and a reply can follow only one of them. The choice decides whose instruction is carried out: the operator’s policy, the user’s request or a line inside a tool result.
paragraphs.zh: 一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体在同一次对话中从多个地方读取指令：操作者的系统提示词、仓库中的配置文件、用户、它所调用工具的输出，以及它在更早会话中保存的笔记。 这些指令常常相互冲突，而一条回复只能遵循其中之一。 这一选择决定了究竟执行谁的指令：是操作者的策略、用户的请求，还是工具结果中的一行内容。

sents.en: An LLM agent reads instructions from several places in one conversation: the operator’s system prompt, a configuration file in the repository, the user, the output of a tool it called, and notes it saved in an earlier session.
sents.zh: 一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体在同一次对话中从多个地方读取指令：操作者的系统提示词、仓库中的配置文件、用户、它所调用工具的输出，以及它在更早会话中保存的笔记。

sents.en: These instructions often disagree, and a reply can follow only one of them.
sents.zh: 这些指令常常相互冲突，而一条回复只能遵循其中之一。

sents.en: The choice decides whose instruction is carried out: the operator’s policy, the user’s request or a line inside a tool result.
sents.zh: 这一选择决定了究竟执行谁的指令：是操作者的策略、用户的请求，还是工具结果中的一行内容。

paragraphs.en: The usual answer is an instruction hierarchy , in which system messages outrank user messages and user messages outrank tool outputs ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) . Benchmarks find that models often break it ( Geng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , but most cannot say why, because a source changes three things at once: its position in the input, the chat role that carries it, and the label that names it. A system prompt comes first, is sent in the system role and reads like a policy, so when a model ignores it, any of the three may be the cause. Constraint benchmarks put both instructions in one message ( He et al., 2026b ; Javed et al., 2026 ) , and most hierarchy benchmarks test one pair at a time, whereas an agent meets conflicts across several messages and among more than two sources. Pairwise results alone cannot determine what a model does when three or more instructions conflict (Appendix G ). No study in Table 1 or Appendix Q varies position, role and label together with the text held fixed, or tests whether pairs forecast larger conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 常见的答案是“指令层级”（instruction hierarchy），其中系统消息的优先级高于用户消息，用户消息的优先级高于工具输出（Wallace et al., 2024）。 基准测试发现模型经常破坏这种层级（Geng et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2025），但大多数研究无法说明原因，因为一个来源同时改变了三件事：它在输入中的位置、承载它的聊天角色，以及命名它的标签。 系统提示词排在最前面，以系统角色发送，且读起来像一份政策，因此当模型忽略它时，三者中的任何一个都可能是原因。 约束类基准把两条指令放在同一条消息中（He et al., 2026b；Javed et al., 2026），而大多数层级基准一次只测试一对来源，然而智能体会在多条消息之间以及多于两个来源之间遭遇冲突。 仅凭两两对比的结果无法确定当三条或更多指令发生冲突时模型会怎么做（附录 G）。 表 1 或附录 Q 中没有任何研究在文本保持不变的情况下同时变化位置、角色和标签，也没有测试两两结果能否预测更大规模的冲突。

paragraphs.en: We first build WhoWins , which keeps the text of each instruction fixed and changes only how it reaches the model (Figure 1 ). The instructions are placed in five seats : operator, repository configuration, user, tool result and saved memory note. Seven controlled experiments vary which seats conflict (two, three or five) and in what order, chat role against text label, one message against separate messages, plain lines against realistic context, seats that agree, the number of instructions, and declared priority tiers (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先构建 WhoWins，它保持每条指令的文本不变，仅改变其到达模型的方式（图 1）。 指令被放置在五个位置：操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和保存的记忆笔记。 七个受控实验变化哪些位置发生冲突（两个、三个或五个）及顺序、聊天角色与文本标签、单条消息与多条独立消息、普通文本行与真实场景上下文、相互一致的位置、指令数量，以及声明的优先级层级（第 3.3 节）。

sents.en: We first build WhoWins , which keeps the text of each instruction fixed and changes only how it reaches the model (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 我们首先构建 WhoWins，它保持每条指令的文本不变，仅改变其到达模型的方式（图 1）。

sents.en: The instructions are placed in five seats : operator, repository configuration, user, tool result and saved memory note.
sents.zh: 指令被放置在五个位置：操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和保存的记忆笔记。

sents.en: Seven controlled experiments vary which seats conflict (two, three or five) and in what order, chat role against text label, one message against separate messages, plain lines against realistic context, seats that agree, the number of instructions, and declared priority tiers (Section 3.3 ).
sents.zh: 七个受控实验变化哪些位置发生冲突（两个、三个或五个）及顺序、聊天角色与文本标签、单条消息与多条独立消息、普通文本行与真实场景上下文、相互一致的位置、指令数量，以及声明的优先级层级（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We then run WhoWins on 14 open-weight models and test whether their pairs forecast larger conflicts. Three results bear on assumptions of current hierarchy work. First , constraint benchmarks put both lines in one message ( He et al., 2026b ; Javed et al., 2026 ) , yet whether two lines share a message changes which one wins. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66% of the replies that follow either, and in two messages its share falls by 19.96 to 60.68%, so in these models, when two conflicting lines share one message, their order largely decides the winner. Second , the hierarchy puts the system message on top ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , yet on both Qwen families the system role does not protect a line sent first. The operator line sent first wins less than half of its conflicts with a later line in all 10 Qwen 3 and 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes, while on gpt-oss it wins most when it acts. In tool and file-write tasks, a policy sent first in the system (or developer) message wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in all 26 model-modes, by 6.41 to 48.75%. Third , under Luce’s choice axiom pair strengths fix the choice in any larger set ( Luce, 2005 ) , but a pairwise ranking of seats does not carry over by itself. In every model-mode, forecasts of larger conflicts improve once they know where the task line is, and one strength per seat helps in 10 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes and both gpt-oss models but in only 3 of 10 on Qwen 3. Thinking helps Qwen follow declared tiers, but for every model the data rule out that even two tiers hold in 95% of usable replies. By our keyword patterns, at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag or hedge the conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 我们随后在14个开源权重模型上运行WhoWins，并检验它们的配对结果能否预测更大规模的冲突。 三个结果关系到当前层级研究的假设。 首先，约束基准将两条指令放在同一条消息中（He et al., 2026b; Javed et al., 2026），但两条指令是否共享一条消息会改变哪一条胜出。 在同一条消息内，两条冲突指令中排在前面的一条在随后回复中胜出72.42%至94.66%，而分在两条消息中时其占比下降19.96%至60.68%，因此在这些模型中，当两条冲突指令共享一条消息时，它们的顺序在很大程度上决定了胜者。 其次，层级结构将系统消息置于顶端（Wallace et al., 2024），但在两个Qwen系列上，系统角色并不能保护先发送的指令。 在全部10个Qwen 3和14个Qwen 3.5模型模式下，先发送的操作者指令在与后到指令的冲突中胜出不足一半，而在gpt-oss上，当它起作用时多数情况胜出。 在工具和文件写入任务中，以系统（或开发者）消息先发送的策略，其胜出频率低于同样文本以标注的用户消息先发送的情况，在全部26个模型模式下皆是如此，差距为6.41%至48.75%。 第三，根据Luce选择公理，配对强度可以决定在任何更大集合中的选择（Luce, 2005），但座位的配对排序本身并不会自动延续。 在每个模型模式中，一旦知道任务指令所在的位置，对更大规模冲突的预测就会改善；每个座位一个强度在14个Qwen 3.5模型模式中的10个以及两个gpt-oss模型上有帮助，但在10个Qwen 3模型模式中仅有3个有帮助。 思考模式帮助Qwen遵循声明的层级，但对每个模型而言，数据都排除了在95%的可用回复中哪怕两个层级成立的可能性。 根据我们的关键词模式，在已判定配对的回复中，最多只有2.92%对冲突进行了标记或规避。

paragraphs.en: We make four contributions. (1) WhoWins , 1,080 scenarios in five task types with up to five mutually exclusive options each, scored by code with no LLM judge (Section 3 ). (2) A controlled study of 14 open-weight models from three families ( 0.6B to 122B ), thinking off and on: 26 model-modes and 1,887,356 scored replies, with main findings checked on held-out scenarios (Section 4 ). (3) A test of whether choice models fitted on pairs forecast three- and five-way conflicts (Section 4.4 ). (4) The benchmark and its code, public on GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/anishh15/WhoWins and as the whowins Python package, and every scored reply, which we will release separately (Appendix P ). Appendix P.2 shows how to install the package, score a reply and run a model.

paragraphs.en: Wallace et al. (2024) proposed that models rank system messages over user messages and user messages over tool outputs. Later work trains this ranking with reinforcement learning ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and gpt-oss was trained to follow system over developer over user messages ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . Benchmarks find that models often break the ranking. IHEval covers system, user, history and tool inputs ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Control Illusion sets system against user constraints ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , IH-Benchmark adds conflicts inside tool outputs ( McCauley et al., 2026 ) , and ManyIH declares up to twelve tiers with tags in the prompt ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Each treats a source as one unit, and most test one pair of levels at a time (Table 1 ). We split a source into position, role and label, and test sets of two, three and five seats.
paragraphs.zh: Wallace 等人 （2024）提出模型应将系统消息排在用户消息之上，并将用户消息排在工具输出之上。 后续工作通过强化学习训练这种排序（Guo 等人，2026；Zheng 等人，2026），并且 gpt-oss 被训练为遵循系统消息优先于开发者消息、开发者消息优先于用户消息（Agarwal 等人，2025）。 基准测试发现，模型经常破坏这种排序。 IHEval 覆盖系统、用户、历史和工具输入（Zhang 等人，2025），Control Illusion 将系统约束与用户约束相对置（Geng 等人，2026），IH-Benchmark 增加了工具输出内部的冲突（McCauley 等人，2026），而 ManyIH 则在提示中用标签声明多达十二个层级（Zhang 等人，2026）。 每项工作都将一个来源视为单一单元，且大多数一次只测试一对层级（表 1）。 我们将一个来源拆分为位置、角色和标签，并测试两个、三个和五个席位的集合。

paragraphs.en: Models may read the source from the text as much as from the role. Social framings such as “CEO requires” in one user message move models more than the system role ( Geng et al., 2026 ) , role probes classify injected text by the role it imitates ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Leong, 2026 ) , and trained role separation can depend on closeness to the start of the input ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Balp-Straffon et al. (2026) compare a system–user conflict with the same pair inside one user message, Liao (2026) changes only a textual source marker, and Neumann et al. (2025) move the same information between the system and the user prompt. ChatInject writes injected text in a tool output as chat-template role turns and raises attack success ( Chang et al., 2026 ) . For trivia answers, a “verified source” note backing a wrong answer flips 45–88% of correct answers in seven of eight models, among them Qwen3.5-27B and gpt-oss-20b ( Kumar and Chopra, 2026 ) . These studies move the role or a label, often together with the position. We send the same line in its real role and as labelled user text, first or last, and measure which of several conflicting instructions wins.
paragraphs.zh: 模型对来源的解读可能来自文本本身，而非仅来自角色。 诸如用户消息中的「CEO 要求」这类社会框架比系统角色更能影响模型（Geng et al., 2026），角色探针可以根据注入文本模仿的角色对其进行分类（Ye et al., 2026；Leong, 2026），而且训练出的角色分离可能取决于与输入开头的接近程度（Wang et al., 2025）。Balp-Straffon et al. （2026）比较了系统与用户冲突以及同一条消息放在用户消息内的同一配对，Liao（2026）只改变了文本来源标记，而 Neumann et al. （2025）则将同样的信息在系统提示与用户提示之间移动。 ChatInject 将注入文本以聊天模板角色轮次的形式写入工具输出中，并提高了攻击成功率（Chang et al., 2026）。 在问答题答案上，一条支持错误答案的「已验证来源」注释使八个模型中的七个模型翻转了 45–88% 的正确答案，其中包括 Qwen3.5-27B 和 gpt-oss-20b（Kumar and Chopra, 2026）。 这些研究移动的是角色或某个标签，并且往往连同位置一起移动。 我们将同一行文本以其真实角色发送，以及作为带标签的用户文本发送（置于开头或结尾），并测量几条相互冲突的指令中哪一条胜出。

sents.zh: 模型对来源的解读可能来自文本本身，而非仅来自角色。

paragraphs.en: Models weigh information by its place in the input ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Guo and Vosoughi, 2025 ) , lists of constraints show primacy and recency effects ( Purpura et al., 2026 ) , and benchmarks of conflicting constraints place them inside one user prompt ( He et al., 2026b ; Javed et al., 2026 ) . Agents also take instructions from tool outputs ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) and from saved memory, which attacks can poison ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . We measure order within and across messages, with tool results and memory notes as seats beside the operator and the user.
paragraphs.zh: 模型会根据信息在输入中所处的位置来衡量其权重（Liu et al., 2024；Guo and Vosoughi, 2025），约束列表会表现出首因效应和近因效应（Purpura et al., 2026），而针对相互冲突的约束的基准测试则会把它们放在同一个用户提示中（He et al., 2026b；Javed et al., 2026）。 智能体还会从工具输出（Greshake et al., 2023；Zhan et al., 2024；Debenedetti et al., 2024）以及保存的记忆中接收指令，而攻击可以对这些记忆进行投毒（Chen et al., 2024；Dong et al., 2026）。 我们衡量的是消息内部以及消息之间的顺序，并将工具结果和记忆条目视为与操作者和用户并排的座位。

paragraphs.en: Under Luce’s choice axiom the odds between two options do not depend on the rest of the set ( Luce, 2005 ) , so pair strengths fix the choice in any larger set. Cherapanamjeri et al. (2026) prove that pairwise data cannot identify a correlated choice model, while best-of-three data can. We give an example of the same kind (Appendix G ) and test on data whether pairs forecast three- and five-way conflicts. Chain-of-thought can lower instruction following ( Li et al., 2026 ) , while more reasoning effort raises many-tier accuracy for some models ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; we run the same weights with thinking off and on. Appendix Q covers more work and explains Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Luce 选择公理下，两个选项之间的赔率不依赖于集合中的其余部分（Luce, 2005），因此成对强度可确定任何更大集合中的选择。Cherapanamjeri 等人 （2026）证明成对数据无法识别相关选择模型，而三选一数据则可以。 我们给出一个同类例子（附录 G），并在数据上检验成对结果能否预测三方和五方冲突。 思维链可能降低指令遵循能力（Li 等，2026），而更多的推理努力会提高某些模型的多层级准确率（Zhang 等，2026）；我们对相同的权重分别在关闭和开启思考的状态下运行。 附录 Q 涵盖更多相关工作并解释表 1。

paragraphs.en: A scenario is a task and up to five instructions that cannot all be followed. There are 1,080 scenarios of five task types: which tool to call first, where to write a file, which output format to use, in which order to run three steps, and whether to refuse a gated action (Appendix A ). The first four types have 240 scenarios each. Refusal has 120 with two options, so it enters only two-way conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 一个场景是一项任务加上至多五条无法全部遵循的指令。 共有 1,080 个场景，涵盖五种任务类型：首先调用哪个工具、将文件写入何处、使用哪种输出格式、按什么顺序运行三个步骤，以及是否拒绝一个受控操作（附录 A）。 前四种类型各有 240 个场景。 拒绝类有 120 个场景，包含两个选项，因此只会进入双方冲突。

sents.zh: 前四种类型各有 240 个场景。

paragraphs.en: The options of a scenario set one property to different values: the first tool call, the first write target, the order of three steps, or one property of the output’s format, so a reply’s scored choice matches at most one option. Code scores every reply with four trace checkers and 240 format classifiers, and no LLM judge is used. A reply chose an option, or it is unresolved , off-menu (a clean answer no option asked for), multiple (two answers) or no action .
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景的各选项将某一属性设置为不同的值：首次工具调用、首个写入目标、三个步骤的顺序，或输出格式的某一属性，因此一条回复的得分选择最多只能匹配一个选项。 评测使用四个轨迹检查器和240个格式分类器对每条回复打分，不使用任何 LLM 评审。 一条回复选择了某个选项，或者处于未决、菜单外（一个没有任何选项所要求的干净答案）、多个（两个答案）或无动作状态。

paragraphs.en: The scenarios were written one at a time by Claude Opus 5 agents from a written guide, with no templates or scripted expansion. Two automatic validators screen every scenario for exclusivity and for wording that gives an option away, a coverage check confirms that every scenario has a working checker, the format classifiers are tested on 1,382 written replies, and the authors reviewed every batch before including it (Appendix A ; the prompts are in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些场景由 Claude Opus 5 智能体依据一份书面指南逐一编写，没有使用模板或脚本化扩展。 两个自动验证器会筛查每个场景是否存在排他性问题以及泄露选项措辞的表述，一项覆盖检查确认每个场景都有可用的检查器，格式分类器在 1,382 条书面回复上进行了测试，并且作者在收录前审查了每一批场景（附录 A；提示词见附录 C）。

sents.en: Two automatic validators screen every scenario for exclusivity and for wording that gives an option away, a coverage check confirms that every scenario has a working checker, the format classifiers are tested on 1,382 written replies, and the authors reviewed every batch before including it (Appendix A ; the prompts are in Appendix C ).
sents.zh: 两个自动验证器会筛查每个场景是否存在排他性问题以及泄露选项措辞的表述，一项覆盖检查确认每个场景都有可用的检查器，格式分类器在 1,382 条书面回复上进行了测试，并且作者在收录前审查了每一批场景（附录 A；提示词见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Each instruction arrives from one of five sources, which we call seats (Appendix B ). The operator \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 and the repository configuration \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 share the system message (the developer message on gpt-oss), each under its own label line. The user \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 writes a plain user message. A tool result \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 comes back from a config_read call already in the transcript. A saved memory note \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 arrives as a user message with its own label. The task arrives as a user message; the Ladder and Agreement sets (Section 3.3 ) move it among the other lines, and the other experiments put it last. Box 1 shows one five-way trial and the seat that won it.
paragraphs.zh: 每条指令来自五个来源之一，我们将其称为座位（附录 B）。 操作者 \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 与仓库配置 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 共享同一条系统消息（在 gpt-oss 上是开发者消息），各自带有自己的标签行。 用户 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 写入一条普通用户消息。 工具结果 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 来自对话记录中已有的一次 config_read 调用。 保存的记忆笔记 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 以带有自己标签的用户消息形式到达。 任务以用户消息的形式到达；Ladder 与 Agreement 两个集合（第 3.3 节）会把它移动到其他各行的位置，而其他实验则把它放在最后。 图 1 展示了一次五方竞争试验以及赢得该试验的座位。

paragraphs.en: Each experiment varies one aspect of how the text is delivered and keeps the text fixed (Table 2 ; Appendix D ). The Ladder sends every pair, triple and the five-way set of seats, with each seat carrying each option equally often, and asks every option alone as a control. The system-message seats come first, while the user, tool and memory seats and the task line appear in every order. The Operator test sends the operator line (our name for either system-message seat, \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 or \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2, since both arrive in the system message) against \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3, \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 or \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 in four layouts: in the real system message or as the same labelled text in a user message, before or after the opposing line. Qwen 3.5’s chat template rejects a system message that is not first, so it has three layouts. The Boundary test sends the user’s line and the memory note in two messages or inside the task’s own message, in both orders. The Context set places each instruction of 50 tool and file-write scenarios inside realistic text, such as an operator prompt of about 200 words, and sends it both bare and in context. In the Agreement sets the seats split into two camps over two options, and we score how often the larger camp’s option wins (Appendix K ). Load varies the number of instructions and, at a fixed length, of conflicts, and Tiers tags each instruction with a priority from 1 to 6 under the rule that the lower number wins.
paragraphs.zh: 每个实验只改变文本传递方式的一个方面，而保持文本内容不变（表 2；附录 D）。 阶梯测试会发送每一对、三个一组以及五个席位的组合，每个席位均等地承载每个选项，并将每个选项单独发送作为对照。 系统消息席位排在最前，而用户、工具和记忆席位以及任务行则以各种顺序出现。 操作者测试将操作者行（我们对任一系统消息席位 \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 或 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 的称呼，因为两者都出现在系统消息中）与 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3、\seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 或 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 以四种布局进行对抗：在真实系统消息中，或作为相同的带标签文本出现在用户消息中，且分别在对方行之前或之后。 Qwen 3.5 的聊天模板拒绝不在最前的系统消息，因此它有三种布局。 边界测试将用户的行和记忆便签以两条消息的形式发送，或放在任务自身的消息内，且两种顺序都测试。 上下文集将 50 个工具和文件写入场景中的每条指令嵌入真实文本中，例如约 200 词的操作者提示，并以裸指令和在上下文中两种方式发送。 在一致性集中，各席位围绕两个选项分成两个阵营，我们统计较大阵营的选项获胜的频率（附录 K）。 负载测试改变指令的数量，并在固定长度下改变冲突的数量；层级测试按照数字越小越优先的规则，为每条指令标注 1 到 6 的优先级。

paragraphs.en: We run 14 open-weight models in three families: Qwen 3 (0.6B to 14B; Yang et al., 2025 ), Qwen 3.5 (0.8B to 122B-A10B, two of them mixture-of-experts; Qwen Team, 2026 ) and gpt-oss (20B and 120B; Agarwal et al., 2025 ). Qwen models run with thinking off and on, at one sampling setting per mode for every size, and gpt-oss always reasons, at high effort. That makes 26 model-modes from 14 sets of weights. Every trial is sent three times (the tier trials once), for 1,887,356 scored replies in all (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了三个系列共 14 个开放权重模型：Qwen 3（0.6B 到 14B；Yang 等，2025）、Qwen 3.5（0.8B 到 122B-A10B，其中两个是专家混合模型；Qwen Team，2026）以及 gpt-oss（20B 和 120B；Agarwal 等，2025）。 Qwen 模型分别在关闭思考和开启思考两种模式下运行，每种模式在每个规模上只使用一个采样设置，而 gpt-oss 始终以高强度进行推理。 这就得到了来自 14 组权重的 26 种模型-模式组合。 每个试验发送三次（层级试验只发送一次），共计得到 1,887,356 条已评分回复（附录 E）。

sents.en: We run 14 open-weight models in three families: Qwen 3 (0.6B to 14B; Yang et al., 2025 ), Qwen 3.5 (0.8B to 122B-A10B, two of them mixture-of-experts; Qwen Team, 2026 ) and gpt-oss (20B and 120B; Agarwal et al., 2025 ).
sents.zh: 我们运行了三个系列共 14 个开放权重模型：Qwen 3（0.6B 到 14B；Yang 等，2025）、Qwen 3.5（0.8B 到 122B-A10B，其中两个是专家混合模型；Qwen Team，2026）以及 gpt-oss（20B 和 120B；Agarwal 等，2025）。

sents.en: Qwen models run with thinking off and on, at one sampling setting per mode for every size, and gpt-oss always reasons, at high effort.
sents.zh: Qwen 模型分别在关闭思考和开启思考两种模式下运行，每种模式在每个规模上只使用一个采样设置，而 gpt-oss 始终以高强度进行推理。

sents.en: That makes 26 model-modes from 14 sets of weights.
sents.zh: 这就得到了来自 14 组权重的 26 种模型-模式组合。

sents.en: Every trial is sent three times (the tier trials once), for 1,887,356 scored replies in all (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 每个试验发送三次（层级试验只发送一次），共计得到 1,887,356 条已评分回复（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: A reply is usable when it was not cut off and carries no recorded fault, and a usable reply is decided when it chose an option that a seat asked for. Rates are shares of decided replies, and a difference between two rates is absolute and written with a percent sign. We give 95% bootstrap intervals that resample scenarios, and pair a contrast within the scenario whenever both layouts are sent for it. A count of model-modes that go one way includes those whose interval excludes 50% or zero, uncorrected. Findings from an exploratory analysis of Qwen 3 were fixed in writing before any measure was computed on Qwen 3.5 or gpt-oss, and then tested on those families; further patterns were found on one random half of the scenarios and tested on the other (Table 9 ). With Benjamini–Hochberg over all 2,103 tests, the main contrasts hold on both halves in at least 25 of 26 model-modes (Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 当一条回复未被截断且没有记录在案的过错时，该回复即为可用回复；当回复选择了某个席位所要求的选项时，即判定为可用回复。 比率是已判定回复所占的份额，两个比率之间的差值为绝对差值，并以百分号书写。 我们给出通过重采样场景得到的 95% 自助法置信区间，并且当同一场景发送了两种布局时，在该场景内进行配对比较。 指向某一方向的模型-模式计数包括置信区间不包含 50% 或零的那些，未经校正。 在对 Qwen 3 进行探索性分析后，其发现在对 Qwen 3.5 或 gpt-oss 计算任何度量之前已书面固定，随后在这些模型家族上加以检验；进一步的规律在随机一半场景上发现，并在另一半场景上检验（表 9）。 对全部 2,103 次检验进行 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正后，主要对比在 26 个模型-模式中至少 25 个的两半数据上均成立（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether pairs predict larger conflicts, we fit choice models ( fits ) on the Ladder pairs alone and score their forecasts of every triple and five-way set by log score. The position fit scores each line by its rank among the conflicting lines, the task-aware fit also knows whether a line comes before or after the task line, and the seats fit adds one strength per seat to position, as a Luce model ( Luce, 2005 ) . We report the share of the gap recovered , which is 0% for a uniform guess and 100% for the empirical reference (each seat set and order predicted by its outcomes, ignoring the task line) (Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验配对结果是否能预测更大的冲突，我们仅在阶梯配对上拟合选择模型（fits），并用对数得分评估它们对每一个三元组和五元集合的预测。 位置拟合按每一行在冲突行中的排名来打分，任务感知拟合还知道某一行位于任务行之前还是之后，而席位拟合在位置的基础上为每个席位增加一个强度参数，作为一个 Luce 模型（Luce, 2005）。 我们报告差距恢复的比例，均匀猜测为 0%，经验参照（由各结果预测每个席位集合和顺序，忽略任务行）为 100%（附录 J）。

sents.en: We report the share of the gap recovered , which is 0% for a uniform guess and 100% for the empirical reference (each seat set and order predicted by its outcomes, ignoring the task line) (Appendix J ).
sents.zh: 我们报告差距恢复的比例，均匀猜测为 0%，经验参照（由各结果预测每个席位集合和顺序，忽略任务行）为 100%（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 gives the main measures for every model-mode, and Appendices H , J and M add intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 给出了每个模型-模式的各项主要度量，附录 H、J 和 M 补充了区间。

paragraphs.en: The first line of a message wins. When two conflicting lines share one message, the first wins 72.42 to 94.66% of decided replies, and in two messages that share falls by 19.96 to 60.68% (Figure 2 ; Appendix H.4 ). This holds on both halves of the scenarios. Across two messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%, and the later message wins in 16 of 26 model-modes. The first line also wins inside the system message. When \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 and \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 share it, the second line wins only 10.80 to 36.21% of the time, below half in all 26 model-modes. Across messages the families differ. On Qwen 3 the first of two messages keeps only 25.04 to 48.48%, while gpt-oss is close to even (53.15 to 53.40%).
paragraphs.zh: 消息的第一行获胜。 当两条冲突的行位于同一条消息中时，第一行在 72.42% 到 94.66% 的已判定回复中获胜；而当冲突分布在两条消息中时，这一比例下降到 19.96% 到 60.68%（图 2；附录 H.4）。 这在场景的两半上都成立。 在跨两条消息的情况下，该比例保持在 22.95% 到 62.65%，并且后一条消息在 26 个模型-模式中的 16 个里获胜。 在系统消息内部，第一行同样获胜。 当 \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 和 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 共享该系统消息时，第二行仅在 10.80% 到 36.21% 的情况下获胜，在全部 26 个模型-模式中均低于一半。 跨消息时，各模型家族表现不同。 在 Qwen 3 上，两条消息中的第一条仅保持 25.04% 到 48.48% 的胜率，而 gpt-oss 接近五五开（53.15% 到 53.40%）。

sents.zh: 消息的第一行获胜。

sents.zh: 跨消息时，各模型家族表现不同。

sents.en: On Qwen 3 the first of two messages keeps only 25.04 to 48.48%, while gpt-oss is close to even (53.15 to 53.40%).
sents.zh: 在 Qwen 3 上，两条消息中的第一条仅保持 25.04% 到 48.48% 的胜率，而 gpt-oss 接近五五开（53.15% 到 53.40%）。

paragraphs.en: Whether order or the operator line wins depends on the family. Qwen 3 follows the later message, gpt-oss follows the developer message, and Qwen 3.5 is in between (Figure 3 ; Appendix H.2 ). When the user, tool and memory seats meet in both orders, the later line wins 69.36 to 89.05% on Qwen 3, 59.77 to 80.52% on Qwen 3.5 and 51.37 to 57.86% on gpt-oss. The operator line, always first in the Ladder, wins 6.07 to 17.35% of its conflicts on Qwen 3, 11.66 to 41.50% on Qwen 3.5, and 62.94% and 75.73% on gpt-oss. Every Qwen 3 point lies below the dashed line, so on Qwen 3 the operator line wins less often than an early user, tool or memory line does against a later one. The contrast holds at a similar total size with the same serving software (vLLM 0.28; Appendix E ): gpt-oss-120b keeps its operator line 75.73% of the time, against 34.97% and 36.76% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. Counting every usable reply, including those in which gpt-oss takes no action (Appendix N ), gpt-oss-120b is still higher, at 51.03% [48.01, 53.95] against 29.64% and 30.51%, while gpt-oss-20b falls to 34.57%. This matches how gpt-oss was trained, to rank system over developer over user messages ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , although its chat format and serving release also differ, and the family has only two models (see Limitations, item 3).
paragraphs.zh: 究竟是顺序还是操作员行获胜，取决于模型家族。 Qwen 3 遵循较后的消息，gpt-oss 遵循开发者消息，而 Qwen 3.5 介于两者之间（图 3；附录 H.2）。 当用户、工具和记忆席位同时以两种顺序出现时，较后的一行在 Qwen 3 上以 69.36% 到 89.05% 获胜，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 59.77% 到 80.52%，在 gpt-oss 上为 51.37% 到 57.86%。 在阶梯中始终位于首位的操作员行，在 Qwen 3 上赢得其冲突的 6.07% 到 17.35%，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 11.66% 到 41.50%，在 gpt-oss 上为 62.94% 和 75.73%。 Qwen 3 的每个数据点都位于虚线之下，因此在 Qwen 3 上，操作员行战胜较早的用户、工具或记忆行的情形，要少于较早一行战胜较后一行的情形。 在总规模相近且使用相同服务软件的条件下（vLLM 0.28；附录 E），这一对比依然成立：gpt-oss-120b 在 75.73% 的情况下保留其操作员行，而 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 仅为 34.97% 和 36.76%。 统计所有可用回复，包括 gpt-oss 未采取任何行动的回复（附录 N），gpt-oss-120b 仍然更高，为 51.03% [48.01, 53.95]，对照 29.64% 和 30.51%，而 gpt-oss-20b 则降至 34.57%。 这与 gpt-oss 的训练方式相符，即将系统消息排在开发者消息之上、开发者消息排在用户消息之上（Agarwal et al., 2025），尽管其聊天格式和发布的服务版本也有所不同，而且该家族只有两个模型（见局限性第 3 条）。

paragraphs.en: In tool and file-write tasks the system message lowers operator wins. When the task is to call a tool or write a file, an operator line sent first wins less often in the real system message than as the same labelled text in a user message, in every model-mode, by 6.41 to 48.75% (Figure 4 ; Appendix H.3 ). The cost is 6.41 to 48.75% on Qwen 3, 8.70 to 29.59% on Qwen 3.5 and 10.96 to 14.15% on gpt-oss; on both halves it holds in 9 of 10 Qwen 3, 14 of 14 Qwen 3.5 and 2 of 2 gpt-oss model-modes. Over all task types the real role still lowers the operator line’s wins in every Qwen model-mode, by 5.07 to 38.14% on Qwen 3 and 4.74 to 25.10% on Qwen 3.5, whereas on gpt-oss it helps in the other task types, by + + 11.29 to + + 13.86% in format and + + 19.27 to + + 25.52% in ordering and refusal.
paragraphs.zh: 在工具和文件写入任务中，系统消息会降低操作者指令的胜率。 当任务是调用工具或写入文件时，作为系统消息真实发送的操作者行，其胜率低于在用户消息中作为相同标注文本出现的情况，且在所有模型-模式下均如此，降幅为 6.41% 至 48.75%（图 4；附录 H.3）。 在 Qwen 3 上降幅为 6.41% 至 48.75%，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 8.70% 至 29.59%，在 gpt-oss 上为 10.96% 至 14.15%；在两个子集上，该现象在 10 个 Qwen 3 模型-模式中的 9 个、14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型-模式中的全部 14 个以及 2 个 gpt-oss 模型-模式中的全部 2 个中均成立。 在所有任务类型上，真实角色仍会在每一个 Qwen 模型-模式中降低操作者行的胜率，在 Qwen 3 上降幅为 5.07% 至 38.14%，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 4.74% 至 25.10%；而在 gpt-oss 上，它在其他任务类型中反而起到帮助作用，在格式任务中提升 + + 11.29% 至 + + 13.86%，在排序与拒绝任务中提升 + + 19.27% 至 + + 25.52%。

paragraphs.en: All three chat formats write the tool definitions into the system or developer turn ( Kundel, 2025 ; Appendix C ), so the real role places the operator line beside them and the labelled text after them, and this contrast does not separate the two. In format tasks, which offer no task tools, the drop appears in 0 of 26 model-modes. Sent last, a gpt-oss developer message wins 87.63 to 87.75% against 54.23 to 62.83% for the same labelled text. On Qwen 3, which accepts a late system message, sending the policy last raises the operator line’s wins by 19.79 to 48.22%, to a majority in 3 of 10 model-modes. In the Context set, where each line is placed inside realistic text, the gpt-oss operator line sent first falls by 15.12 to 29.77%, and on Qwen the change goes both ways (Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 三种聊天格式都将工具定义写入系统或开发者回合（Kundel, 2025；附录C），因此真实角色会把操作员行放在工具定义旁边、把带标签文本放在其后，而这一对比无法将二者区分开。 在不提供任务工具的格式任务中，下降仅在0个模型-模式中出现。 最后发送时，gpt-oss开发者消息以87.63至87.75%胜出，而相同带标签文本仅为54.23至62.83%。 在接受迟发系统消息的Qwen 3上，最后发送策略使操作员行的胜率提升19.79至48.22%，在10个模型-模式中的3个达到多数。 在Context集合中，每行文本都置于真实语境之中，先发送的gpt-oss操作员行下降15.12至29.77%，而在Qwen上这一变化则是双向的（附录I）。

paragraphs.en: Two models can agree on every pairwise rate and still pick different winners when three lines conflict (Appendix G ), so whether pairs predict larger sets has to be measured. We fit the three choice models of Section 3.4 to each model-mode’s pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 即使两个模型在每一对比较的胜率上都一致，当三条线发生冲突时它们仍可能选出不同的赢家（附录 G），因此“成对结果能否预测更大的集合”必须经过实测。 我们将 3.4 节中的三个选择模型拟合到每个模型-模式的成对数据上。

paragraphs.en: Knowing where the task line is improves the forecast in every model-mode. The task-aware fit forecasts larger conflicts better than the position fit in all 26 model-modes, by 0.012 to 0.113 nats per reply. In the pairs, the later line on Qwen 3 wins less when both lines come before the task line than when the task comes first or between them, by 16.80 to 29.29%. A line after the task may read as a correction to it.
paragraphs.zh: 知道任务行在哪里能改善每种模型模式下的预测。 在全部 26 种模型模式中，任务感知拟合对较大冲突的预测优于位置拟合，每条回复高出 0.012 到 0.113 nats。 在这些配对中，当两行都位于任务行之前时，Qwen 3 上较晚的一行胜出的次数少于任务行在前或位于两行之间时，差距为 16.80% 到 29.29%。 任务行之后的一行可能被理解为对该任务行的更正。

sents.zh: 知道任务行在哪里能改善每种模型模式下的预测。

paragraphs.en: Seat strengths help on Qwen 3.5 and gpt-oss but rarely on Qwen 3. Adding one strength per seat to the position fit improves the forecast in 10 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes and both gpt-oss models, but in only 3 of 10 on Qwen 3 (Figure 5 ; Appendix J ). The gain reaches + + 0.139 nats per reply on Qwen 3.5 and is 0.028 to 0.054 on gpt-oss. Added to the task-aware fit instead, seat strengths still help in 10 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes, both gpt-oss models and 3 of 10 on Qwen 3. How much of the gap the position fit recovers still differs by family, with 49.86 to 61.77% on Qwen 3, 4.69 to 49.88% on Qwen 3.5 and 0.90 to 26.71% on gpt-oss.
paragraphs.zh: 席位强度在 Qwen 3.5 和 gpt-oss 上有帮助，但在 Qwen 3 上很少有帮助。 为每个席位向位置拟合添加一个强度，在 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型-模式中的 10 个以及两个 gpt-oss 模型上改进了预测，但在 Qwen 3 上仅在 10 个中的 3 个有改进（图 5；附录 J）。 该增益在 Qwen 3.5 上达到 + + 0.139 nats 每条回复，在 gpt-oss 上为 0.028 至 0.054。 若改为添加到任务感知拟合中，席位强度仍在 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型-模式中的 10 个、两个 gpt-oss 模型以及 Qwen 3 的 10 个中的 3 个上有帮助。 位置拟合能弥补多大比例的差距仍因模型家族而异，在 Qwen 3 上为 49.86% 至 61.77%，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 4.69% 至 49.88%，在 gpt-oss 上为 0.90% 至 26.71%。

paragraphs.en: Thinking helps follow declared tiers. With thinking on, Qwen models follow an explicit priority rule more often, at every Qwen 3 size from 4B up and every Qwen 3.5 size from 2B up (Figure 6 a; Appendix L ). When each line carries a tier from 1 to 6, thinking raises the share of decided replies that follow the rule by up to + + 25.83% on Qwen 3.5 (paired, Table 20 ), and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B goes from 75.67% to 95.44%. However, in all 26 model-modes the data rule out that even two declared tiers are followed in 95% of usable replies (Appendix M ). Here a reply that acts on neither option counts as a failure, so Qwen3.5-27B with thinking on follows it in 98.51% of decided replies but 87.08% of usable ones.
paragraphs.zh: 思考有助于遵循声明的层级。 开启思考后，Qwen 模型更频繁地遵循显式优先级规则，从 4B 起的每个 Qwen 3 规模和从 2B 起的每个 Qwen 3.5 规模都是如此（图 6 a；附录 L）。 当每行携带 1 到 6 的层级时，思考使遵循规则的已决回复占比在 Qwen 3.5 上最多提升 + + 25.83%（配对检验，表 20），Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 从 75.67% 提升到 95.44%。 然而，在全部 26 个模型-模式中，数据排除了即使只有两个声明层级的遵循率在可用回复中达到 95% 的可能性（附录 M）。 这里，对两个选项都未采取行动的回复计为失败，因此开启思考的 Qwen3.5-27B 在已决回复中 98.51% 遵循该规则，但在可用回复中只有 87.08%。

sents.en: Thinking helps follow declared tiers.
sents.zh: 思考有助于遵循声明的层级。

sents.en: With thinking on, Qwen models follow an explicit priority rule more often, at every Qwen 3 size from 4B up and every Qwen 3.5 size from 2B up (Figure 6 a; Appendix L ).
sents.zh: 开启思考后，Qwen 模型更频繁地遵循显式优先级规则，从 4B 起的每个 Qwen 3 规模和从 2B 起的每个 Qwen 3.5 规模都是如此（图 6 a；附录 L）。

sents.en: When each line carries a tier from 1 to 6, thinking raises the share of decided replies that follow the rule by up to + + 25.83% on Qwen 3.5 (paired, Table 20 ), and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B goes from 75.67% to 95.44%.
sents.zh: 当每行携带 1 到 6 的层级时，思考使遵循规则的已决回复占比在 Qwen 3.5 上最多提升 + + 25.83%（配对检验，表 20），Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 从 75.67% 提升到 95.44%。

sents.en: However, in all 26 model-modes the data rule out that even two declared tiers are followed in 95% of usable replies (Appendix M ).
sents.zh: 然而，在全部 26 个模型-模式中，数据排除了即使只有两个声明层级的遵循率在可用回复中达到 95% 的可能性（附录 M）。

sents.en: Here a reply that acts on neither option counts as a failure, so Qwen3.5-27B with thinking on follows it in 98.51% of decided replies but 87.08% of usable ones.
sents.zh: 这里，对两个选项都未采取行动的回复计为失败，因此开启思考的 Qwen3.5-27B 在已决回复中 98.51% 遵循该规则，但在可用回复中只有 87.08%。

paragraphs.en: Thinking raises the operator line on Qwen 3. With the operator line first in the real system message, thinking raises its wins at 4 of 5 Qwen 3 sizes ( + + 1.07 to + + 12.94%), 4 of them on both halves (Figure 6 b). On Qwen 3.5 it lowers them at 5 of 7 sizes (all seven: − - 12.78 to + + 2.09%), but only 2 of these hold on both halves.
paragraphs.zh: 思维模式在 Qwen 3 上提升了算符线。 当算符线位于真实系统消息的首位时，思维模式在 5 个 Qwen 3 尺寸中的 4 个上提升了其胜率（+ + 1.07 至 + + 12.94%），其中 4 个在两半部分均成立（图 6 b）。 在 Qwen 3.5 上，它在 7 个尺寸中的 5 个上降低了胜率（全部七个：− - 12.78 至 + + 2.09%），但其中只有 2 个在两半部分均成立。

sents.en: Thinking raises the operator line on Qwen 3.
sents.zh: 思维模式在 Qwen 3 上提升了算符线。

paragraphs.en: Models rarely say there is a conflict. In every model-mode, at most 2.92% of decided pair replies flag the conflict or hedge by our keyword patterns, so a decided reply rarely tells the user that an instruction was dropped (Appendix N ). He et al. (2026b) report the same for constraints in one message. The number of instructions in a prompt shows no consistent effect across families in our ten Load bundles (Appendix O ).
paragraphs.zh: 模型很少明示存在冲突。 在每种模型模式下，经我们关键词模式检测，已决断的成对回复中最多只有 2.92% 标记冲突或含糊其辞，因此已决断的回复很少告诉用户某条指令被丢弃了（附录 N）。He 等人 （2026b）针对单条消息中的约束报告了同样的结果。 在我们的十个 Load 任务包中，提示中指令的数量在各模型家族间没有一致的影响（附录 O）。

sents.en: Models rarely say there is a conflict.
sents.zh: 模型很少明示存在冲突。

sents.zh: （2026b）针对单条消息中的约束报告了同样的结果。

sents.en: The number of instructions in a prompt shows no consistent effect across families in our ten Load bundles (Appendix O ).
sents.zh: 在我们的十个 Load 任务包中，提示中指令的数量在各模型家族间没有一致的影响（附录 O）。

paragraphs.en: The results suggest six practices for agent builders and benchmark designers. (i) For tool and file-write tasks, test where a policy is placed instead of assuming the system prompt protects it, since a policy sent first there wins less often than the same words in a user turn in all 26 model-modes. (ii) On Qwen 3 and gpt-oss, test sending the policy after the competing line, which raises its wins by 19.79 to 48.22% on Qwen 3 and 12.49 to 20.41% on gpt-oss, although on Qwen 3 it then wins a majority in only 3 of 10 model-modes and recency also favours injected lines. (iii) Test conflicts across messages as well as inside one, because the first line’s advantage shrinks across messages. (iv) Before ranking seats, model where the task line is, since doing so improves the forecast of larger conflicts in all 26 model-modes. (v) Test each conflict on several scenarios and replies, since even the empirical reference names the winner in only 44.44 to 69.70% of replies (Appendix J ). (vi) Do not count on declared tiers or on a warning, since no model keeps even two tiers in order in 95% of usable replies and few replies mention the conflict (Section 4.5 ; Appendices M and N ).
paragraphs.zh: 结果为智能体构建者和基准设计者提出了六项实践建议。 (i) 对于工具和文件写入任务，应测试策略放置的位置，而不是假设系统提示词就能保护它，因为在全部 26 个模型-模式中，先发送的策略在该处获胜的频率低于同样的文字放在用户回合中的情况。 (ii) 在 Qwen 3 和 gpt-oss 上，测试将策略放在竞争行之后发送，这使其在 Qwen 3 上的获胜率从 19.79% 提高到 48.22%，在 gpt-oss 上从 12.49% 提高到 20.41%，不过在 Qwen 3 上，策略此时仅在 10 个模型-模式中的 3 个中赢得多数，且近因效应也有利于被注入的行。 (iii) 除了测试单条消息内部的冲突，还要测试跨消息的冲突，因为第一行的优势在跨消息时会缩小。 (iv) 在对位置进行排序之前，先对任务行所在的位置进行建模，因为这样做在全部 26 个模型-模式中都改善了对较大冲突的预测。 (v) 在多个场景和回复上测试每个冲突，因为即使是经验性参照，也只能在 44.44% 到 69.70% 的回复中指明获胜者（附录 J）。 (vi) 不要指望声明的层级或警告，因为没有模型能在 95% 的可用回复中保持哪怕两个层级的顺序，而且很少有回复提到冲突（第 4.5 节；附录 M 和 N）。

sents.zh: 结果为智能体构建者和基准设计者提出了六项实践建议。

paragraphs.en: We separated an instruction’s source into position, chat role and label. Across 14 open-weight models and 1,887,356 replies, the winner depends on position and message boundaries as well as on the role . 1) In every model the first of two lines in one message wins most decided replies, and on Qwen the later line often wins across messages. 2) A policy sent first in the system message wins most of its decided conflicts with later lines only on gpt-oss, and in tool and file-write tasks it wins less often than the same text sent first as a labelled user message, in every model-mode. 3) Pair forecasts of larger conflicts improve in all model-modes once they model where the task line is in the prompt. Hierarchy benchmarks should therefore vary position and message boundaries as well as the role.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将一条指令的来源区分为位置、聊天角色和标签。 在 14 个开放权重模型和 1,887,356 条回复中，获胜者不仅取决于角色，还取决于位置和消息边界。1) 在所有模型中，同一条消息内两行中的第一行在大多数有明确结果的回复中获胜，而在 Qwen 上，跨消息时后面的行往往获胜。2) 系统消息中先发送的策略，仅在 gpt-oss 上能赢得其与后面的行之间大多数有明确结果的冲突；而在工具和文件写入任务中，同一段文本先作为带标签的用户消息发送时，在所有模型-模式下获胜的频率都更高。3) 一旦对提示词中任务行所在位置进行建模，所有模型-模式下对更大冲突的成对预测都会改善。 因此，层级基准应当在变化角色之外，同时变化位置和消息边界。

paragraphs.en: Open models only. We test 14 open-weight models from three families, served locally so that the weights, chat templates and sampling settings are fixed. Hosted models add system prompts and input handling that users cannot see. The benchmark can be adapted to other chat APIs, but our conclusions cover these three families.
paragraphs.zh: 仅限开放模型。 我们测试了来自三个系列的 14 个开放权重模型，并在本地部署服务，从而固定权重、对话模板和采样设置。 托管模型会增加用户无法查看的系统提示词和输入处理。 该基准测试可以适配其他对话 API，但我们的结论仅涵盖这三个系列。

sents.en: Open models only.
sents.zh: 仅限开放模型。

sents.en: We test 14 open-weight models from three families, served locally so that the weights, chat templates and sampling settings are fixed.
sents.zh: 我们测试了来自三个系列的 14 个开放权重模型，并在本地部署服务，从而固定权重、对话模板和采样设置。

sents.zh: 托管模型会增加用户无法查看的系统提示词和输入处理。

sents.zh: 该基准测试可以适配其他对话 API，但我们的结论仅涵盖这三个系列。

paragraphs.en: Short, synthetic instructions. Most instructions are one line, written by Claude Opus 5 agents and reviewed by the authors. Only the Context set embeds them in realistic text, for 50 scenarios. All text is in English, each seat has one label wording, and each trial is one task of at most six tool turns.
paragraphs.zh: 简短的合成指令。 大多数指令只有一行，由 Claude Opus 5 智能体撰写，并由作者审核。 只有 Context 集将它们嵌入到真实文本中，涵盖 50 个场景。 所有文本均为英文，每个席位只有一种标签措辞，每次试验是一个最多包含六次工具调用的任务。

sents.en: Short, synthetic instructions.
sents.zh: 简短的合成指令。

sents.en: Most instructions are one line, written by Claude Opus 5 agents and reviewed by the authors.
sents.zh: 大多数指令只有一行，由 Claude Opus 5 智能体撰写，并由作者审核。

sents.en: Only the Context set embeds them in realistic text, for 50 scenarios.
sents.zh: 只有 Context 集将它们嵌入到真实文本中，涵盖 50 个场景。

sents.en: All text is in English, each seat has one label wording, and each trial is one task of at most six tool turns.
sents.zh: 所有文本均为英文，每个席位只有一种标签措辞，每次试验是一个最多包含六次工具调用的任务。

paragraphs.en: Family contrasts mix several differences. gpt-oss differs from Qwen in training and in chat format at once, and Qwen 3 ran on an older vLLM release in float16 while the other models ran on a newer release in bfloat16, with gpt-oss’s expert weights in MXFP4 (Appendix E ). gpt-oss also runs at the Qwen thinking sampling setting, and its family has two models. A contrast between families therefore does not isolate one cause.
paragraphs.zh: 家族间对比混杂了多个差异。gpt-oss 与 Qwen 在训练和对话格式上同时存在差异，而且 Qwen 3 在较旧版本的 vLLM 上以 float16 运行，其他模型则在较新版本上以 bfloat16 运行，其中 gpt-oss 的专家权重采用 MXFP4（附录 E）。gpt-oss 还使用 Qwen 思考模式的采样设置，且其家族包含两个模型。 因此，家族之间的对比无法分离出单一的原因。

sents.en: Family contrasts mix several differences. gpt-oss differs from Qwen in training and in chat format at once, and Qwen 3 ran on an older vLLM release in float16 while the other models ran on a newer release in bfloat16, with gpt-oss’s expert weights in MXFP4 (Appendix E ). gpt-oss also runs at the Qwen thinking sampling setting, and its family has two models.

sents.zh: 因此，家族之间的对比无法分离出单一的原因。

paragraphs.en: What each measure covers. Rates are shares of decided replies; Appendices H and N give rates over all usable replies for the main measures. In tasks with tools, each chat template writes the tool definitions into the system or developer turn, so the role contrast also moves the policy relative to them. Thinking off and on each use their own sampling setting (Appendix E ), so a thinking contrast compares two configurations. Flagging is found by fixed keyword patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 各项指标所涵盖的内容。 比率是已判定回复中的占比；附录 H 和 N 给出了主要指标在所有可用回复上的比率。 在使用工具的任务中，每个聊天模板都会将工具定义写入系统轮次或开发者轮次，因此角色对比也会使策略相对它们发生移动。 关闭思考和开启思考各自使用自己的采样设置（附录 E），因此思考对比实际上是比较两种配置。 标记是通过固定的关键词模式来判定的。

sents.zh: 标记是通过固定的关键词模式来判定的。

paragraphs.en: The study involves no human subjects and no personal data. All models are open-weight models used under their published licences (Appendix E ). The scenarios describe ordinary software tasks with no offensive content, and the refusal task type asks only whether to run a gated, harmless action in a sandbox. The authoring guides forbid naming real people, companies or products (Prompts 11 and 12), and the authors reviewed every batch.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者，也不涉及个人数据。 所有模型均为开放权重模型，并按照其发布的许可证使用（附录 E）。 各场景描述的是普通的软件任务，不包含攻击性内容，且拒绝类任务仅询问是否在沙箱中运行一个受限制但无害的操作。 编写指南禁止提及真实的人名、公司或产品（提示 11 和 12），且作者审查了每一批次。

sents.en: The study involves no human subjects and no personal data.
sents.zh: 本研究不涉及人类受试者，也不涉及个人数据。

sents.en: All models are open-weight models used under their published licences (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 所有模型均为开放权重模型，并按照其发布的许可证使用（附录 E）。

sents.en: The scenarios describe ordinary software tasks with no offensive content, and the refusal task type asks only whether to run a gated, harmless action in a sandbox.
sents.zh: 各场景描述的是普通的软件任务，不包含攻击性内容，且拒绝类任务仅询问是否在沙箱中运行一个受限制但无害的操作。

sents.zh: 编写指南禁止提及真实的人名、公司或产品（提示 11 和 12），且作者审查了每一批次。

paragraphs.en: Knowing where an instruction is most likely to be followed could help an attacker place an injected line, and the same knowledge tells defenders where a policy holds best. We release no attack and no injection payloads beyond the benchmark’s plain conflicting instructions. A policy sent first in the system message wins fewer than half of its conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model we test, so an agent that relies on such a policy without testing it may act against it. Section 4.6 lists practices for such tests.
paragraphs.zh: 知道一条指令最有可能在哪里被遵循，可以帮助攻击者放置注入行，而同样的知识也能告诉防御者哪里的策略最为稳固。 除基准测试中普通的冲突指令外，我们不发布任何攻击手段和注入载荷。 在我们测试的每个 Qwen 模型中，置于系统消息最前面的策略在与后续行的冲突中获胜比例不到一半，因此依赖此类策略而不加测试的智能体可能会做出违背该策略的行为。 第 4.6 节列出了此类测试的实践做法。

sents.en: Knowing where an instruction is most likely to be followed could help an attacker place an injected line, and the same knowledge tells defenders where a policy holds best.
sents.zh: 知道一条指令最有可能在哪里被遵循，可以帮助攻击者放置注入行，而同样的知识也能告诉防御者哪里的策略最为稳固。

sents.en: We release no attack and no injection payloads beyond the benchmark’s plain conflicting instructions.
sents.zh: 除基准测试中普通的冲突指令外，我们不发布任何攻击手段和注入载荷。

sents.en: Section 4.6 lists practices for such tests.
sents.zh: 第 4.6 节列出了此类测试的实践做法。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 gives one scenario per task type. The tool type offers five stub tools and reads which one the model calls first. The file-write type offers five destinations inside a sandbox and reads where the first write goes, after normalising the path; a write to a sub-path of a destination counts as that destination, and a bare name counts as the one destination whose last segment it is. The format type covers 240 kinds of output rule (key casing, delimiters, date encodings, list styles, units and more), each with its own classifier and five labels. The ordering type reads the order in which three marked steps are first performed, with other calls in between ignored. The refusal type asks whether to run a gated action; complying is a call to the action’s tool and declining is a call to a dedicated decline_the_action tool, so both are actions in the trace. A reply that calls neither tool counts as declining only if it says so in its own words; otherwise it is no action. The scenarios span coding, data, devops, support and 28 other domain labels.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 给出了每种任务类型的一个场景。 工具类型提供五个桩工具，并读取模型首先调用了哪一个。 文件写入类型提供沙箱内的五个目标位置，并在规范化路径后读取首次写入到哪里；对某个目标位置的子路径的写入算作该目标位置，而裸名称算作其作为最后一段的那个目标位置。 格式类型涵盖 240 种输出规则（键的大小写、分隔符、日期编码、列表样式、单位等），每种规则都有各自的分类器和五个标签。 顺序类型读取三个被标记步骤首次被执行的顺序，其间其他调用被忽略。 拒绝类型询问是否运行一个受控操作；同意执行即调用该操作的工具，拒绝执行即调用专门的 decline_the_action 工具，因此两者在轨迹中都是操作。 既不调用这两个工具的回复，只有在其用自己的话语明确表示拒绝时才计为拒绝；否则不算任何操作。 这些场景涵盖编码、数据、运维、支持以及 28 个其他领域标签。

paragraphs.en: Every reply is given one of five behaviours: chose (exactly one value among the options shown in the trial), unresolved (an artifact no classifier could label), off-menu (a clean value no option in the trial asked for), multiple (two or more options’ values, for example two fenced answers) or no action (the trace holds no action of the kind the key reads). Separately, each reply is marked as flagging the conflict, hedging or silent , since a model can name a conflict and still choose one option without resolving it. These marks come from fixed keyword patterns over the answer text, and the reasoning is not read. A reply cut off by the length limit or carrying a recorded fault (output the parser or a checker could not read) is unusable and is left out of every rate except the strict counts of Appendix L , which score it as a failure. The agent may call tools for up to six turns. Tool calls from all turns are read in order, so the first call or write counts, and a call to config_read , which a trial offers only to carry \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4, is never read as a choice; a format reply is scored on its last turn that is more than talk or a closing note.
paragraphs.zh: 每个回复被归入五种行为之一：选择（在被试条目展示的选项中恰好选择一个值）、未解决（任何分类器都无法标注的产物）、超出选项（一个干净的值但不属于该条目的任何选项）、多选（两个或更多选项的值，例如两个围栏答案）或无动作（轨迹中不包含键所读取的那类动作）。 另外，每个回复还会被标注为指出冲突、含糊其辞或沉默，因为模型可以点名冲突却仍然选择某个选项而不解决它。 这些标注来自对答案文本的固定关键词模式，推理过程不会被读取。 被长度上限截断或带有已记录故障（输出解析器或检查器无法读取）的回复视为不可用，并被排除在所有比率之外，但附录 L 的严格计数除外，在那里它被计为失败。 智能体最多可以进行六轮工具调用。 所有轮次的工具调用按顺序读取，因此第一次调用或写入生效，而对 config_read 的调用（某条目仅为了承载 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 才提供该调用）永远不会被读作选择；格式回复按其最后一轮超出闲聊或收尾说明的内容计分。

paragraphs.en: Claude Opus 5 agents, working in two separate set-ups, wrote the scenarios, and the authors reviewed them. All scenarios are in English. The agents worked in batches of at most 50, one scenario at a time, from a written guide. Each batch had to pass seven screens: every option reads the same single-valued key, with the exclusivity argument written out; no two scenarios share a set of values; the options of a scenario are within 20% of each other in length; no option is the sensible answer on the task’s merits; each scenario says where such an instruction would come from in practice; domains and difficulty are spread; and each scenario names its own underlying situation. There are no templates and no scripted expansion. Every scenario records which set-up wrote it.
paragraphs.zh: Claude Opus 5 智能体在两个独立的设置下撰写了这些场景，作者对其进行了审阅。 所有场景均为英文。 智能体按照最多 50 个一批的方式工作，每次处理一个场景，并依据一份书面指南进行。 每一批都必须通过七道筛选：每个选项读取同一个单值键，并写出排他性理由；没有两个场景共享一组值；同一场景的各选项长度相差不超过 20%；没有任何选项就任务本身而言是合理的答案；每个场景都说明这类指令在实际情况中会来自何处；领域和难度分布广泛；且每个场景都点明其自身背后的具体情境。 没有模板，也没有脚本化的扩展。 每个场景都记录了是由哪个设置撰写的。

paragraphs.en: One of the 240 format scenarios offers both a JSON object and a YAML mapping; since valid JSON also parses as YAML, its classifier tests JSON first, so in that scenario the scored label, not the two rules alone, separates the options. Two automatic validators check the whole collection. One screens across scenarios for repeated wording and structure, tasks that single out an option, unbalanced option lengths and missing fields. The other enforces each task type’s invariants and counts, and checks that the reference trials still point at real options with matching checkers. The authors then reviewed each batch against the seven screens and returned any batch that failed one for rewriting. Automated tests confirm that the reference trials are rebuilt exactly. The format classifiers are tested against 1,382 written replies, some that should win an option and some adversarial near-misses that should not, and every one of the 1,200 format values is reached by at least one of them. Other tests cover a reply with two answers and a reply that restates an instruction without following it. A reply that describes an answer without carrying it out is not scored as choosing it.
paragraphs.zh: 240 个格式场景中有一个同时提供了 JSON 对象和 YAML 映射；由于合法的 JSON 也能被解析为 YAML，其分类器会先测试 JSON，因此在该场景中，是所评分的标签而不仅仅是那两条规则来区分各个选项。 两个自动验证器会检查整个集合。 一个验证器跨场景排查重复的措辞与结构、单独挑出某个选项的任务、各选项长度不均衡以及字段缺失的问题。 另一个验证器强制执行每种任务类型的不变量和数量要求，并检查参考试运行仍指向真实选项且配有匹配的检查器。 作者随后依据这七道筛查逐批审查，并将未通过其中任一筛查的批次退回重写。 自动化测试确认参考试运行能被精确地重建。 格式分类器针对 1,382 条书面回复进行了测试，其中一些应当赢得某个选项，另一些是本不应赢得选项的对抗性近似样本，并且 1,200 个格式值中的每一个都至少被其中一条回复触及。 其他测试覆盖了包含两个答案的回复，以及复述指令却未执行该指令的回复。 只描述答案而未实际执行的回复，不会被计为选择了该答案。

paragraphs.zh: 表5逐字给出了每个座位的角色及其标签行。 在Context和Tiers集合之外，标签是座位添加的唯一文本；其下方的指令是场景的选项文本，保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Each family’s own chat template turns the messages into the text the model reads, and every request is checked before it is sent: a message that the family’s format would drop, rename or reject is blocked rather than sent in a changed form. Qwen 3 renders a system message wherever it appears, so its operator can come first or last. Qwen 3.5’s template does not accept a system message that is not first, so its operator can only come first, and the Operator test runs three layouts on it. gpt-oss reads the harmony format: our operator seat is its developer message, a later developer message is rendered at its own position, and reasoning runs at high effort. Qwen has no developer message, so none is sent to it. On gpt-oss the system message holds the format’s own identity, date and reasoning-effort lines (Appendix C ), so no seat uses it.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型家族自己的聊天模板会把消息转换成模型读取的文本，并且每个请求在发送前都会经过检查：家族格式会丢弃、重命名或拒绝的消息会被拦截，而不是以改变后的形式发送。 Qwen 3 会在系统消息出现的任何位置渲染它，因此其 operator 可以放在最前或最后。 Qwen 3.5 的模板不接受不在最前面的系统消息，因此其 operator 只能放在最前，并且 Operator 测试会在其上运行三种布局。gpt-oss 读取 harmony 格式：我们的 operator 席位是它的 developer 消息，靠后的 developer 消息会在其自身位置渲染，推理以高强度运行。 Qwen 没有 developer 消息，因此不会向它发送任何 developer 消息。 在 gpt-oss 上，系统消息承载格式自身的身份、日期和推理强度行（附录 C），因此没有席位使用它。

sents.en: Each family’s own chat template turns the messages into the text the model reads, and every request is checked before it is sent: a message that the family’s format would drop, rename or reject is blocked rather than sent in a changed form.
sents.zh: 每个模型家族自己的聊天模板会把消息转换成模型读取的文本，并且每个请求在发送前都会经过检查：家族格式会丢弃、重命名或拒绝的消息会被拦截，而不是以改变后的形式发送。

sents.en: Qwen 3 renders a system message wherever it appears, so its operator can come first or last.
sents.zh: Qwen 3 会在系统消息出现的任何位置渲染它，因此其 operator 可以放在最前或最后。

sents.en: Qwen 3.5’s template does not accept a system message that is not first, so its operator can only come first, and the Operator test runs three layouts on it. gpt-oss reads the harmony format: our operator seat is its developer message, a later developer message is rendered at its own position, and reasoning runs at high effort.
sents.zh: Qwen 3.5 的模板不接受不在最前面的系统消息，因此其 operator 只能放在最前，并且 Operator 测试会在其上运行三种布局。gpt-oss 读取 harmony 格式：我们的 operator 席位是它的 developer 消息，靠后的 developer 消息会在其自身位置渲染，推理以高强度运行。

sents.en: Qwen has no developer message, so none is sent to it.
sents.zh: Qwen 没有 developer 消息，因此不会向它发送任何 developer 消息。

sents.en: On gpt-oss the system message holds the format’s own identity, date and reasoning-effort lines (Appendix C ), so no seat uses it.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss 上，系统消息承载格式自身的身份、日期和推理强度行（附录 C），因此没有席位使用它。

paragraphs.en: A trial offers only the tools its task type is scored on, plus config_read whenever \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 is in the trial (Prompt 2 in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 一次试验只提供其任务类型所评分的工具，另外，只要 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 在该试验中，还会提供 config_read（附录 C 中的提示词 2）。

paragraphs.en: Boxes 2 to 4 show trials of three tests as sent to Qwen3-8B (thinking off).
paragraphs.zh: 方框 2 至 4 展示了发送给 Qwen3-8B（关闭思考模式）的三项测试的试验过程。

paragraphs.en: This section shows every text the benchmark sends to a model, and the prompts the authoring agents worked from. Every string is reproduced verbatim from the benchmark’s code, run settings and data. Boxes 1 to 4 show filled trials; the prompts below show how each message is built. Each message starts with its role in bold. Monospace text is sent exactly as shown: a new line is a line break in the message, and a line that starts with ↪ \hookrightarrow continues the line above it. Text in italics inside angle brackets stands for scenario content, and text in italics inside square brackets is our note. The benchmark adds no other text: there is no system prompt of our own beyond the Tiers rule, and since code scores every reply, there is no judge prompt and no prompt for validation. The benchmark was called Instruction Priority (package ipb ) while the data was written, and the authoring prompts keep that name.
paragraphs.zh: 本节展示了基准测试发送给模型的每一段文本，以及创作智能体所依据的提示词。 所有字符串均逐字复制自基准测试的代码、运行设置和数据。 方框 1 到 4 展示了已填充的试验；下方的提示词展示了每条消息是如何构建的。 每条消息都以加粗的角色名开头。 等宽文本按所示原样发送：换行即消息中的换行符，以 ↪ \hookrightarrow 开头的行续接上一行。 尖括号内的斜体文本代表场景内容，方括号内的斜体文本是我们的注释。 基准测试没有添加任何其他文本：除 Tiers 规则外没有我们自己的系统提示词，而且由于每条回复都由代码评分，因此没有裁判提示词，也没有用于验证的提示词。 在数据编写时，该基准测试名为 Instruction Priority（包名 ipb），创作提示词中保留了该名称。

paragraphs.en: Every Ladder and Agreement trial is built from the messages in Prompt 1. A seat sends its label line, a line break and the option text; the user \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 sends the option text alone. The operator \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 and the repository \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 share the first message, in either order half the time each, which is the system message on Qwen and the developer message on gpt-oss. The tool result \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 answers an assistant turn that calls config_read . The task is its own user message, except in the merged layout of the Boundary test. The order of the user, tool and memory messages and the task changes from trial to trial. In an Agreement trial the seats split into two camps over two options, so two to four seats carry the same option text. A solo control keeps one seat’s messages and the task, and drops the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 Ladder 和 Agreement 试验均由 Prompt 1 中的消息构成。 一个席位发送其标签行、一个换行符和选项文本；用户 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 则单独发送选项文本。 操作者 \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 和仓库 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 共享第一条消息，两种顺序各占一半时间，该消息在 Qwen 上是系统消息，在 gpt-oss 上是开发者消息。 工具结果 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 回应了一个调用 config_read 的智能体回合。 任务是其独立的用户消息，但在 Boundary 测试的合并布局中除外。 用户消息、工具消息、记忆消息和任务的顺序会随试验而变化。 在 Agreement 试验中，各席位围绕两个选项分成两个阵营，因此有两到四个席位携带相同的选项文本。 单席对照组保留一个席位的消息和任务，并舍弃其余内容。

sents.zh: 工具结果 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 回应了一个调用 config_read 的智能体回合。

paragraphs.en: A trial offers only the tools its task can be scored from (Prompt 2). A tool task offers its five stub tools and an ordering task one stub tool per step (for example build , lint , test ); a file-write task offers write_file ; a refusal task offers its action tool and decline_the_action ; a format task offers none. A trial with \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 also offers config_read , and a Load trial offers the tools of its bundle’s tool and file-write scenarios. On both Qwen families the chat template writes this list into the first system turn, together with the operator message when that message comes first; the harmony format of gpt-oss writes it into a developer message.
paragraphs.zh: 一次试验只提供其任务可据以评分的工具（Prompt 2）。 工具任务提供其五个占位工具，排序任务每步提供一个占位工具（例如 build、lint、test）；文件写入任务提供 write_file；拒绝任务提供其动作工具和 decline_the_action；格式任务不提供任何工具。 带 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 的试验还会提供 config_read，Load 试验则提供其捆绑包中工具与文件写入场景的工具。 在两个 Qwen 系列上，聊天模板会将这份列表写入第一个系统轮次，当操作者消息排在最前时还会连同操作者消息一起写入；gpt-oss 的 harmony 格式则将其写入开发者消息中。

paragraphs.en: The model may call tools for up to six turns per reply. Prompt 3 shows what each call returns; the model’s own turn goes back with the answer, without its reasoning. A second config_read call in a trial with \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 gets the \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 text again, so the model is never told something new.
paragraphs.zh: 模型在每次回复中最多可调用工具六轮。 提示 3 展示了每次调用返回的内容；模型自己的回合会连同答案一起返回，但不包含其推理过程。 在带有 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 的试验中，第二次 config_read 调用会再次获取 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 的文本，因此智能体永远不会被告知任何新信息。

A label layout sends the operator’s label line and option text as a user message. The other operator pairs ( \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 or \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 against \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3, \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 or \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5) follow the same pattern. Qwen 3.5’s template refuses a late system message, so it gets no “real, last” layout. Box 2 shows a filled example.

paragraphs.en:
Every request sets every sampling value and its own seed explicitly (Prompt 9; the values are those of Table 7 ). The thinking switch travels as a chat-template setting, never as text in a message. With thinking off, every Qwen template ends the prompt with <think>

paragraphs.en: The ten pairs of seats each meet 108 scenarios (1,080 pair trials), the ten triples 96 each (960), and the five-way set meets 960 scenarios; refusal enters only the pairs. Options are dealt so that within every set of seats each seat carries each option equally often, to within one trial, so no option is tied to a seat or a position. Each side of every conflict is also asked alone in the same layout (9,840 solo trials), which tells us how often a model follows an instruction when nothing opposes it. The operator \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 and the repository \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 share the system message and so come first, in either order half the time each, whereas \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3, \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 and \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 appear in every order. Their three pairs and their triple are therefore free , meaning each pair is seen both ways round. The task line moves among the user-side lines, so a line can come before or after it.
paragraphs.zh: 十组两席位各应对108种情境（共1,080次两席位试验），十组三席位各应对96种情境（共960次），五席位组合应对960种情境；拒答仅出现在两席位中。 选项的分配使得在每个席位集合内，每个席位以尽可能均匀的频次（误差不超过一次试验）承担每个选项，因此任何选项都不与某个席位或某个位置绑定。 每个冲突中的每一方还会在相同布局下被单独询问（共9,840次单人试验），这能告诉我们当没有对立因素时，模型遵循指令的频率如何。 算子 \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 与存储库 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 共享系统消息，因此排在最前，两者的先后顺序各占一半；而 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3、\seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 和 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 则以所有可能的顺序出现。 因此，它们的三组两席位组合及三席位组合是自由的，这意味着每个两席位组合都会以两种顺序各出现一次。 任务行在用户侧行之中移动，因此某一行可能位于它之前或之后。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario meets one of six seat pairs ( \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 or \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 against \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3, \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 or \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5), taken in turn within each task type, so each pair meets 180 scenarios. It is sent in four layouts with the same two options: the operator line in the real system message or as the same labelled text in a user message, before or after the opposing line; the task message always comes after both. Which two options are used, and which seat carries which, rotate across the scenarios of a pair, so both directions occur equally often. Qwen 3.5 gets no “real, last” layout, because its chat template rejects a system message that is not first.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景会遇到六种座位配对之一（\seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 或 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2 对阵 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3、\seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 或 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5），在每种任务类型内依次进行，因此每个配对会遇到 180 个场景。 它以四种布局发送，且两个选项相同：操作者一行放在真实的系统消息中，或以同样的带标签文本放在用户消息中，位置在对阵一行之前或之后；任务消息始终在这两行之后。 使用哪两个选项，以及哪个座位承担哪一方，会在配对的各场景间轮换，因此两个方向出现的频率相等。 Qwen 3.5 没有获得「真实、最后」布局，因为其聊天模板拒绝不排在首位的系统消息。

sents.zh: Qwen 3.5 没有获得「真实、最后」布局，因为其聊天模板拒绝不排在首位的系统消息。

paragraphs.en: Every fourth scenario (270) sets the user \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 against the memory note \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 in four layouts: each in its own user message or both inside the task’s message, each in both orders. We compare the share of decided replies that follow the first-listed line between the merged and separate layouts, paired within the scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 每四个场景中有一个（270）在四种布局下将用户 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 与记忆便签 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 进行对比：各自放在单独的用户消息中，或两者都放在任务的消息中；两种顺序各测一次。 我们比较合并布局与分开布局下，遵循先列出的一方的已决定回复占比，并在场景内部进行配对比较。

sents.en: Every fourth scenario (270) sets the user \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 against the memory note \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 in four layouts: each in its own user message or both inside the task’s message, each in both orders.
sents.zh: 每四个场景中有一个（270）在四种布局下将用户 \seatchip seatThreeFillseatThreeLineS3 与记忆便签 \seatchip seatFiveFillseatFiveLineS5 进行对比：各自放在单独的用户消息中，或两者都放在任务的消息中；两种顺序各测一次。

paragraphs.en: Fifty scenarios (25 tool, 25 file-write), spread over domains, each get four written contexts: an operator prompt of about 200 words, a user request, a repository file returned by config_read and a page of saved notes. Each context holds the instruction once, as a whole sentence in its middle 60% of words; a validator rejects any context that names a tool or option, uses another seat’s label or says which source outranks which. Each item is sent under six pairs of seats, in both orders where the format allows, bare and in context, with the same two options in every layout.
paragraphs.zh: 五十个场景（25个工具类，25个文件写入类），分布于多个领域，每个场景配有四种书面上下文：一段约200字的操作员提示、一条用户请求、一份由 config_read 返回的仓库文件，以及一页保存的笔记。 每个上下文中指令只出现一次，作为完整句子位于其词语的中间60%范围内；校验器会拒绝任何点名某个工具或选项、使用其他席位标签或说明哪个来源优先于哪个来源的上下文。 每个条目在六对席位下发送，在格式允许的情况下按两种顺序发送，分别以裸文本和带上下文的形式，且每种排布中使用相同的两个选项。

paragraphs.en: This test uses 80 groupings of three to five seats in which some seats ask for the same option: 30 triples with two seats agreeing, 35 four-seat sets (three agree, or two pairs agree) and 15 five-seat sets (four agree, or two and three agree). They are dealt like the Ladder, are never used for fitting, and are predicted by choice models fitted on the Ladder pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试使用80组由三至五个席位构成的组合，其中一些席位选择同一选项：30组三人组合（两个席位意见一致）、35组四人组合（三个一致，或两两一致）以及15组五人组合（四个一致，或二加三一致）。 它们的发放方式与阶梯（Ladder）相同，从不用于拟合，并由在阶梯对上拟合的选择模型进行预测。

paragraphs.en: The test has ten written bundles (a worked bundle and nine replicates), each a task with six component scenarios and ten trials on a grid of n ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 12 } n\in\{2,4,8,12\} instructions and k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 , 6 } k\in\{0,1,3,6\} conflict groups (ten ( n , k ) (n,k) conditions; k = 0 k=0 only up to n = 8 n=8 ). The instructions are in the operator message and the task is its own user message. Filler lines replace conflict lines, so at each n n the instruction list has the same length in Qwen tokens whatever k k is. At fixed n n we therefore read a change in the share chosen as an effect of conflict, and a change across n n at one conflict group as an effect of load ( k = 0 k=0 has no conflict group to score).
paragraphs.zh: 该测试包含十个书面任务包（一个示范包和九个重复包），每个任务包是一项任务，包含六个组成部分场景，并在 n ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 12 } 条指令和 k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 , 6 } 个冲突组的网格上进行十次试验（共十种 ( n , k ) 条件；k = 0 仅到 n = 8 为止）。 指令位于操作员消息中，任务本身就是其自身的用户消息。 填充行替换冲突行，因此在每个 n 下，无论 k 为何值，指令列表在 Qwen 词元上的长度都相同。 因此，在固定 n 下，我们把被选比例的变化解读为冲突的效应，而在同一冲突组下跨 n 的变化解读为负载的效应（k = 0 时没有可供评分的冲突组）。

paragraphs.en: Two options of a scenario are each tagged [priority: t t ] with t t from 1 to 6, under a system rule that the lower number wins. Each scenario meets six of the 15 tier pairs, so every pair gets 432 items. Within each tier pair the winning tier falls on the scenario’s earlier- and later-listed option equally often, and is shown first or second equally often (108 items in each of the four cases). Each trial is sent once.
paragraphs.zh: 按照数字越小优先级越高的系统规则，一个场景的两个选项分别被标记 [priority: t t ]，其中 t t 从 1 到 6。 每个场景满足 15 个层级对中的六个，因此每个层级对得到 432 个条目。 在每个层级对内，胜出层级落在场景中较早列出和较晚列出的选项上的频率相同，且其显示在第一位或第二位的频率也相同（四种情况各 108 个条目）。每个试次只发送一次。

paragraphs.en: All sampling settings are set explicitly in every request (Table 7 ). Qwen models run at one setting per mode for every size, so a difference between sizes within a mode is never also a difference in sampling. Thinking off and on use different settings, so a thinking contrast changes the sampling as well. Both are the settings recommended on the Qwen 3 model cards for that mode, and the thinking setting is also the Qwen 3.5 model cards’ recommendation for precise coding. The presence penalty is 0 for every model, because it lowers the chance of tokens already written, such as JSON quotes and tool-call tags, and would favour some options for reasons the instructions do not give. gpt-oss uses the thinking setting at high reasoning effort, so every thinking run is sampled the same way. The output limit is the same for every model, so a cut-off reply means the same thing everywhere. Each draw gets its own seed, derived from the run’s seed, the trial and the repeat, so every request can be sent again with the same seed, although another serving stack need not return the same tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 所有采样设置都在每次请求中显式设定（表 7）。 Qwen 模型在每个尺寸、每种模式下只使用一种设置，因此同一模式下不同尺寸之间的差异绝不会同时也是采样上的差异。 关闭思考与开启思考使用不同的设置，因此思考相关的对比也会改变采样设置。 这两种设置都是 Qwen 3 模型卡片针对相应模式推荐使用的设置，而开启思考的设置同时也是 Qwen 3.5 模型卡片对精确编码场景的推荐设置。 所有模型的出现惩罚均为 0，因为它会降低已出现过的词元（如 JSON 引号和工具调用标签）再次出现的概率，并会以指令未给出的理由偏向某些选项。gpt-oss 在高推理努力下使用思考设置，因此所有思考相关的运行都采用相同的采样方式。 输出上限对所有模型都相同，因此被截断的回复在任何地方都意味着同样的情况。 每次抽样都有各自的随机种子，由该运行的种子、试验编号和重复编号推导而来，因此每个请求都可以用相同的种子重新发送，尽管其他服务栈不一定返回相同的词元。

paragraphs.en: A reply is usable when it was not cut off by the length limit and carries no recorded fault. A usable reply is decided when it chose an option and exactly one seat in play asked for that option (in the Agreement sets, any option a seat asked for). Rates are shares of decided replies unless a column is marked “all usable”; there every usable reply counts, and a reply that no single seat won (for example, one that asks a question instead of acting) is a loss for every side. Appendix N gives the share of decided replies for every model-mode.
paragraphs.zh: 当一条回复未被长度上限截断且没有任何记录在案的故障时，即视为可用。 当一条可用回复选择了某个选项，且对局中恰好有一个席位请求了该选项时，即视为已判定（在 Agreement 集合中，任何席位请求过的选项均可）。 各比率为已判定回复中的占比，除非某列标注为「全部可用」；在该列中，每条可用回复都计入，而没有任何单一席位获胜的回复（例如，以提问代替行动的回复）对每一方都记为失败。 附录 N 给出了每个「模型-模式」的已判定回复占比。

paragraphs.en: A rate is the sum of wins over the sum of decided replies. Its 95% interval is a percentile bootstrap with 2,000 resamples of scenarios (of items for the Context set and of bundles for Load), so the three draws of a trial and the trials of a scenario move together. A contrast between two layouts of the same scenarios resamples both together, which pairs them within the scenario; a contrast between groups of replies, such as flagged against silent, resamples each group separately. A difference between two rates is absolute and written with a percent sign.
paragraphs.zh: 比率是胜出次数与已判定回复总数之和的比值。 其 95% 区间采用百分位自助法，对情境（Context 集合中的条目、Load 中的捆绑包）进行 2,000 次重抽样，因此一次试验的三次抽取以及同一情境的各次试验会一起变动。 对相同情境的两种布局进行比较时，两者一起重抽样，从而在情境内部实现配对；对回复组的比较（例如被标记的与静默的）则对每一组分别重抽样。 两个比率之间的差异为绝对值，并用百分号表示。

sents.zh: 比率是胜出次数与已判定回复总数之和的比值。

paragraphs.en: A hash of each scenario’s identifier splits the scenarios into two fixed halves. Findings from an exploratory analysis of Qwen 3 were fixed in writing before any measure was computed on Qwen 3.5 or gpt-oss; further patterns were looked for on the first half and tested unchanged on the second, and Table 9 reports each finding on both halves. The restriction of the role contrast to tool and file-write tasks is one of these later patterns. Each listed test (one measure on one model-mode and one half; a thinking contrast per Qwen size and half; the Load measures on all data) gets a two-sided p-value from its bootstrap standard error, against 50% for a rate and 0 for a difference. All 2,103 tests are corrected together by Benjamini–Hochberg at q = 0.05 q=0.05 , with Holm’s correction beside it. Throughout the paper, a count such as “25 of 26 model-modes” includes only the model-modes whose 95% interval excludes 50% for a rate or 0 for a difference; these counts are not corrected for multiple tests. Under Benjamini–Hochberg, the Boundary contrast and the task-aware gain hold on both halves in 26 and 26 of 26 model-modes, and the tool and file-write role contrast and the operator line’s rate against 50% in 25 and 25.
paragraphs.zh: 对每个情景标识符取哈希值，将情景划分为固定的两半。 在对 Qwen 3 进行探索性分析后，其发现在对 Qwen 3.5 或 gpt-oss 计算任何度量之前已被书面固定；随后在前一半数据上寻找更多模式，并在后一半数据上不加改动地进行检验，表 9 报告了每项发现在两半数据上的结果。 将角色对比限定于工具任务和文件写入任务，就是这些后来发现的模式之一。 每项列出的检验（某一模型-模式某一数据半上的一个度量；每个 Qwen 规模每个数据半的一个思考对比；所有数据上的 Load 度量）都根据其自助法标准误得到双侧 p 值，比率以 50% 为原假设，差值以 0 为原假设。 全部 2,103 项检验在 q = 0.05 下统一用 Benjamini–Hochberg 方法进行校正，并同时给出 Holm 校正作为对照。 在全文中，诸如「26 个模型-模式中的 25 个」这样的计数，仅包括其 95% 区间对比率而言不包含 50%、对差值而言不包含 0 的模型-模式；这些计数未做多重检验校正。 在 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正下，Boundary 对比和任务感知增益在 26 个模型-模式中的 26 个上于两半数据均成立，工具任务和文件写入任务的角色对比以及算子行的比率对 50% 的检验则在 26 个模型-模式中的 25 个上于两半数据均成立。

sents.zh: 对每个情景标识符取哈希值，将情景划分为固定的两半。

paragraphs.en: All forecasting models are conditional logits fitted by maximum likelihood on the Ladder pairs. Uniform gives every option in play the same chance, with one fitted term for replies that no seat won. Position scores each conflicting line by its rank among them, from 0 (first) to 1 (last). Task-aware gives that rank one weight for lines before the task line and another for lines after it, and adds one term for coming after the task. Seats adds one strength per seat to position (a Luce model with position), and task-aware + seats adds them to the task-aware fit. Luce uses the seat strengths alone. The empirical reference predicts each set of seats in each order by the outcome frequencies observed for it in the scored replies, the same replies it is scored on. It pools scenarios and ignores where the task line is, so no forecast that sees only the seats and their order can score higher on these data. A reply with no winner is an outcome of its own in every model. The main text fits all pairs and scores all triples and five-way sets; Appendix J also fits the pairs of one half of the scenarios and scores the larger sets of the other half, in both directions. The log score is the mean log probability a forecast gave to what happened, in nats per reply; top-1 accuracy is the share of replies whose winner the forecast rated highest. The share of the gap recovered is

paragraphs.en: Pairwise results alone cannot determine what a model does when three or more instructions conflict (Section 1 ). Pairwise rates fix only how often each line beats each other line; they say nothing about how those preferences are correlated, and the winner of a larger set depends on the correlation ( Cherapanamjeri et al., 2026 ) . Under an assumption such as Luce’s choice axiom, pairs fix it ( Luce, 2005 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅有成对比较结果无法确定当三条或更多指令发生冲突时模型会做什么（第 1 节）。 成对比率只固定了每条指令击败其他每条指令的频率；它们完全没有说明这些偏好之间是如何相关的，而更大集合的胜者取决于这种相关性（Cherapanamjeri et al., 2026）。 在诸如 Luce 选择公理之类的假设下，成对比较可以将其固定下来（Luce, 2005）。

paragraphs.en: The two worlds give the same pairwise data however many pairs are observed, so any forecast built from pairs alone gives both the same triple prediction. The best such prediction, ( 0.35 , 0.35 , 0.30 ) (0.35,0.35,0.30) , is still 0.066 0.066 nats per reply short of the truth in each world, the smallest worst-case loss any pair-only forecast can reach. A Luce model fitted to the pairs predicts ( 7 / 17 , 7 / 17 , 3 / 17 ) (7/17,7/17,3/17) and is 0.112 0.112 nats short in both. More pairwise data does not shrink either gap.
paragraphs.zh: 无论观察到多少对，两个世界给出的成对数据都相同，因此仅由成对数据构建的任何预测对两个世界给出相同的三元预测。 这样的最佳预测 ( 0.35 , 0.35 , 0.30 ) (0.35,0.35,0.30) 在两个世界中仍比真值少 0.066 0.066 nat 每次回复，这是任何仅用成对数据的预测所能达到的最小最坏情况损失。 用成对数据拟合的 Luce 模型预测 ( 7 / 17 , 7 / 17 , 3 / 17 ) (7/17,7/17,3/17)，在两个世界中都短缺 0.112 0.112 nat。 更多的成对数据无法缩小这两个差距中的任何一个。

paragraphs.en: WhoWins therefore collects triples and five-way sets from the start and scores pair-only forecasts against them (Section 4.4 ). The answer depends on the family: from pairs alone, the task-aware fit recovers 60.08 to 75.81% of the gap on Qwen 3 but only 5.67 to 31.51% on gpt-oss.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，WhoWins 从一开始就收集三元组和五元集合，并将仅包含配对的预测对照这些数据进行评分（见第 4.4 节）。 答案取决于模型家族：仅凭配对数据，任务感知拟合在 Qwen 3 上可以弥补 60.08% 至 75.81% 的差距，但在 gpt-oss 上仅能弥补 5.67% 至 31.51%。

paragraphs.en: This section checks each main finding of Sections 4.1 to 4.5 on the two halves of the scenarios, then gives every Ladder, Operator and Boundary measure for every model-mode. A difference column is paired within the scenario. It uses only the scenarios with decided replies in both layouts, so it can differ slightly from the gap between the two rates beside it.
paragraphs.zh: 本节在两半场景上核查第 4.1 至 4.5 节的每项主要发现，然后给出每个模型-模式的所有 Ladder、Operator 和 Boundary 指标。 差异列在场景内配对。 它只使用两种版式中均有确定回复的场景，因此可能与旁边的两个比率之间的差距略有不同。

paragraphs.en: Later wins : the later of two lines wins in free Ladder pairs (user, tool result, memory note; both orders). 2nd sys. line : the second of the two system-message lines ( \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 and \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2, each order half the time) wins. First, one msg. and sep. msgs. : the first-listed of the user line and the memory note wins when both are inside the task’s message, or in separate messages (Boundary). Operator first : the operator line ( \seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 or \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2), first in the Ladder, wins against a later user, tool or memory line. Real − - label ∗ : in tool-call and file-write tasks, the operator line sent first in the real system message minus the same text sent first as a labelled user message (Operator). Late op. gain : the real operator line sent last minus sent first. User > > tool : the user line beats the tool result, both orders. Tier rule : the declared lower tier wins (Tiers). Seat gain : nats per reply that one strength per seat adds to the position fit when forecasting triples and five-way sets from pairs. Shading in the difference columns reaches full tone at ± \pm 50% ( ± \pm 0.1 nats for the seat gain).
paragraphs.zh: 后者胜出：在自由 Ladder 配对中，两行中靠后者胜出（用户、工具结果、记忆备注；两种顺序均适用）。第二条系统消息行：两条系统消息行（\seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 和 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2，各占一半顺序）中的第二条胜出。 首条消息与分离消息：当用户行与记忆备注同在任务的消息内，或位于各自独立的消息中（Boundary）时，列表在前的用户行与记忆备注中先列出者胜出。 操作者在前：操作者行（\seatchip seatOneFillseatOneLineS1 或 \seatchip seatTwoFillseatTwoLineS2）在 Ladder 中排在前面，胜出其后出现的用户、工具或记忆行。 真实 − 带标签 ∗：在工具调用与文件写入任务中，真实系统消息中先发送的操作者行，减去作为带标签用户消息先发送的相同文本（Operator）。 后置操作者增益：真实操作者行最后发送减去最先发送。 用户 ≫ 工具：用户行胜过工具结果，两种顺序均如此。 层级规则：声明较低的层级胜出（Tiers）。 席位增益：从配对预测三元组与五元组合时，每个席位的强度为位置拟合增加的 nat 数（每条回复）。 差值列中的着色在 ± \pm 50% 处达到全色调（席位增益为 ± \pm 0.1 nats）。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 lists each main finding and the model-modes in which it holds. A finding holds when its 95% interval excludes the null in the stated direction: one half for a rate, zero for a difference. paragraphs.en: Some findings hold on both halves in every model-mode. The first-listed line wins inside one message, and loses part of that lead across messages, in all 26 model-modes on both halves. The task-aware fit also beats the position fit in every model-mode on both halves.
paragraphs.zh: 有些发现在每个“模型-模式”的两半数据上都成立。 在所有26个“模型-模式”的两半数据上，同一条消息内以首个列出的行为胜者，而跨消息时该领先优势会部分丧失。 在每个“模型-模式”的两半数据上，任务感知拟合也胜过位置拟合。

paragraphs.en: Findings that differ by family also replicate. The pinned operator wins on both halves in 2 of 2 gpt-oss models, against 0 of 10 Qwen 3 and 0 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes. The later line wins on both halves in 10 of 10 Qwen 3 and 14 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes, and in 0 of 2 on gpt-oss. The real system role loses to its label on both halves in 10 of 10 and 14 of 14 Qwen model-modes, and in 0 of 2 on gpt-oss. Seat strengths add to position on both halves in 9 of 14 Qwen 3.5 and 2 of 2 gpt-oss model-modes, against 3 of 10 on Qwen 3.
paragraphs.zh: 因家族而异的发现同样得到了复现。 在 2 个 gpt-oss 模型中，固定算子（pinned operator）在两半上均获胜；而 Qwen 3 的 10 个模型模式中为 0 个，Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型模式中为 0 个。 后一行（later line）在 Qwen 3 的 10 个模型模式中的 10 个以及 Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型模式中的 14 个里均在两半上获胜，而在 gpt-oss 的 2 个中为 0 个。 真实的 system 角色在 Qwen 的 10 个模型模式中的 10 个以及 14 个模型模式中的 14 个里均在两半上输给其标签，而在 gpt-oss 的 2 个中为 0 个。 座位强度在两半上与位置相加，在 Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型模式中的 9 个以及 gpt-oss 的 2 个模型模式中的 2 个里成立，而 Qwen 3 的 10 个中为 3 个。
