paragraphs.en: Some findings replicate only in part. The user beats the tool result on both halves in 8 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes and in 1 of 10 on Qwen 3. The held-out half passes more model-modes than the discovery half here (14 against 8 on Qwen 3.5), so the pattern is not specific to the discovery half. The weaker recency when both lines precede the task holds on both halves in 8 of 10 Qwen 3 and 6 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes. The drop in operator wins with thinking on holds on both halves at 2 of 7 Qwen 3.5 sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 一些发现仅部分复现。 用户在 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型模式中的 8 个以及在 Qwen 3 的 10 个中的 1 个里，在两半上都胜过工具结果。 在这里，留出半通过的模型模式多于发现半（Qwen 3.5 上为 14 对 8），因此该模式并非发现半所特有。 当两行都先于任务时，较弱的近因效应在 10 个 Qwen 3 模型模式中的 8 个和 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型模式中的 6 个里在两半上都成立。 开启思考时操作者胜出次数的下降，在 7 个 Qwen 3.5 规模中的 2 个上于两半都成立。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows the three pairs among the user, tool and memory seats for every model-mode. A user line beats a tool result by point estimate in every model-mode, with the interval above one half in 20 of 26 (panel a). The user and the memory note are close to even, with Qwen3.5-27B the clearest exception (panel b). A memory note beats a tool result on gpt-oss and in several Qwen 3.5 model-modes, and Qwen3.5-27B with thinking on is the one model-mode where the tool result clearly wins (panel c).
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了每个「模型-模式」下用户、工具与记忆三个席位之间的三组配对。 在所有「模型-模式」中，用户发言的点估计均优于工具结果，且 26 个中有 20 个的区间高于二分之一（面板 a）。 用户发言与记忆笔记大致相当，Qwen3.5-27B 是最明显的例外（面板 b）。 记忆笔记在 gpt-oss 及多个 Qwen 3.5「模型-模式」中优于工具结果，而开启思考模式的 Qwen3.5-27B 是工具结果明显胜出的唯一「模型-模式」（面板 c）。

paragraphs.en: Order flips at the message boundary. Across messages the later of two lines wins 69.36 to 89.05% on Qwen 3 and 59.77 to 80.52% on Qwen 3.5, yet inside one system message the second line wins only 10.80 to 36.21%. The later line wins with its interval above one half in 25 of 26 model-modes, and gpt-oss is closest to even at 51.37 to 57.86%. The second of two operator lines in one system message wins less than half the time in 26 of 26 model-modes, with the interval below one half in each. The Boundary test finds the same split with the user and memory lines (Table 15 ).
paragraphs.zh: 顺序在消息边界处发生翻转。 跨消息时，两行中较后一行的胜率为 Qwen 3 上的 69.36% 至 89.05%，Qwen 3.5 上的 59.77% 至 80.52%；然而在同一条系统消息内，第二行仅以 10.80% 至 36.21% 的胜率获胜。 在 26 个模型-模式中的 25 个里，较后一行获胜，且其区间高于二分之一；gpt-oss 最接近持平，为 51.37% 至 57.86%。 在同一条系统消息中，两行操作员指令中的第二行在 26 个模型-模式中的 26 个里胜率均低于一半，且每个区间都低于二分之一。 边界测试在用户行与记忆行上发现了同样的划分（表 15）。

sents.en: Order flips at the message boundary.
sents.zh: 顺序在消息边界处发生翻转。

sents.zh: 跨消息时，两行中较后一行的胜率为 Qwen 3 上的 69.36% 至 89.05%，Qwen 3.5 上的 59.77% 至 80.52%；然而在同一条系统消息内，第二行仅以 10.80% 至 36.21% 的胜率获胜。

sents.zh: 在 26 个模型-模式中的 25 个里，较后一行获胜，且其区间高于二分之一；gpt-oss 最接近持平，为 51.37% 至 57.86%。

sents.zh: 在同一条系统消息中，两行操作员指令中的第二行在 26 个模型-模式中的 26 个里胜率均低于一半，且每个区间都低于二分之一。

sents.zh: 边界测试在用户行与记忆行上发现了同样的划分（表 15）。

paragraphs.en: Recency is strongest when the later line follows the task. When both lines come before the task line, the later line’s advantage shrinks by 16.80 to 29.29% on Qwen 3, with the interval below zero in 10 of 10 model-modes. On Qwen 3.5 the drop is 2.52 to 34.56%, below zero in 13 of 14. On gpt-oss it is 5.63 to 11.17% and both intervals span zero. One reading is that a Qwen model treats a line that arrives after the task as an update to it. The task-aware fit of Appendix J is built on this pattern.
paragraphs.zh: 当较晚的行出现在任务之后时，近因效应最强。 当两行都出现在任务行之前时，在 Qwen 3 上较晚行的优势缩小 16.80% 至 29.29%，10 个模型-模式中的 10 个区间低于零。 在 Qwen 3.5 上降幅为 2.52% 至 34.56%，14 个中有 13 个低于零。 在 gpt-oss 上为 5.63% 至 11.17%，且两个区间都跨越零。 一种解释是，Qwen 模型把在任务之后出现的行视为对该任务的更新。 附录 J 中感知任务的拟合正是建立在这一模式之上。

sents.en: Recency is strongest when the later line follows the task.
sents.zh: 当较晚的行出现在任务之后时，近因效应最强。

sents.en: When both lines come before the task line, the later line’s advantage shrinks by 16.80 to 29.29% on Qwen 3, with the interval below zero in 10 of 10 model-modes.
sents.zh: 当两行都出现在任务行之前时，在 Qwen 3 上较晚行的优势缩小 16.80% 至 29.29%，10 个模型-模式中的 10 个区间低于零。

sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss 上为 5.63% 至 11.17%，且两个区间都跨越零。

sents.zh: 一种解释是，Qwen 模型把在任务之后出现的行视为对该任务的更新。

sents.en: The task-aware fit of Appendix J is built on this pattern.
sents.zh: 附录 J 中感知任务的拟合正是建立在这一模式之上。

paragraphs.en: The operator line wins only on gpt-oss. Pinned first, the operator or repository line wins 62.94 to 75.73% on gpt-oss, against 11.66 to 41.50% on Qwen 3.5 and 6.07 to 17.35% on Qwen 3. In pinned pairs the system-message seats always come first, so on Qwen this rate also carries the cost of an early position. gpt-oss often asks a question instead of acting (Appendix N ). Counting every usable reply, with a reply that no single seat won as a loss, gpt-oss-120b still keeps its operator 51.03% of the time, against 29.64% and 30.51% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B with thinking off and on. On the same count gpt-oss-20b falls to 34.57%, just below Qwen3.5-27B with thinking off (35.39%). Within Qwen 3.5 the pinned operator does best in the 27B and the 122B-A10B (41.50% and 34.97% with thinking off, against 14.73% for the 9B). The same two models have the lowest position share in Qwen 3.5: position alone recovers only 4.69% and 9.54% of their forecasting gap (Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 操作员线仅在 gpt-oss 上胜出。 固定席位时，操作员线或仓库线在 gpt-oss 上以 62.94% 至 75.73% 胜出，而在 Qwen 3.5 上为 11.66% 至 41.50%，在 Qwen 3 上为 6.07% 至 17.35%。 在固定的对局中，系统消息席位总是排在前位，因此在 Qwen 上，该比率还包含早期位置的代价。gpt-oss 经常以提问代替行动（附录 N）。 统计所有可用回复，并将无单一席位胜出的回复计为失败，gpt-oss-120b 仍能在 51.03% 的情况下保住其操作员，而 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在关闭和开启思考模式下分别为 29.64% 和 30.51%。 按同一统计口径，gpt-oss-20b 降至 34.57%，略低于关闭思考模式的 Qwen3.5-27B（35.39%）。 在 Qwen 3.5 内部，固定操作员在 27B 和 122B-A10B 上表现最好（关闭思考模式下分别为 41.50% 和 34.97%，而 9B 仅为 14.73%）。 这两个模型在 Qwen 3.5 中的位置占比也最低：仅凭位置因素只能解释其预测差距的 4.69% 和 9.54%（附录 J）。

sents.en: The operator line wins only on gpt-oss.
sents.zh: 操作员线仅在 gpt-oss 上胜出。

sents.en: Pinned first, the operator or repository line wins 62.94 to 75.73% on gpt-oss, against 11.66 to 41.50% on Qwen 3.5 and 6.07 to 17.35% on Qwen 3.

sents.zh: 按同一统计口径，gpt-oss-20b 降至 34.57%，略低于关闭思考模式的 Qwen3.5-27B（35.39%）。

sents.en: Within Qwen 3.5 the pinned operator does best in the 27B and the 122B-A10B (41.50% and 34.97% with thinking off, against 14.73% for the 9B).
sents.zh: 在 Qwen 3.5 内部，固定操作员在 27B 和 122B-A10B 上表现最好（关闭思考模式下分别为 41.50% 和 34.97%，而 9B 仅为 14.73%）。

paragraphs.en: Users beat tool results, partly without any conflict. Pooled over both orders, the user line beats the tool result 59.93 to 78.51% on Qwen 3.5 and 68.63 to 77.16% on gpt-oss, with the interval above one half in 14 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes. This holds on both halves in 8 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes and 1 of 2 gpt-oss models. On Qwen 3 the rate is 52.57 to 73.33%, above one half in 4 of 10. Part of this gap exists with no conflict at all. Asked alone, a user line is carried out more often than the same line returned by a tool, by 0.07 to 25.44%, with the interval above zero in 23 of 26 model-modes.
paragraphs.zh: 用户指令胜过工具结果，部分情况下两者并无任何冲突。 合并两种顺序来看，用户指令行的执行率以 59.93% 比 78.51% 高于工具结果（Qwen 3.5 上），在 gpt-oss 上为 68.63% 比 77.16%，其中区间超过一半的情况在 Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型-模式中有 14 个。 在 Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型-模式中有 8 个、gpt-oss 的 2 个模型中有 1 个，这一点在两个半区上均成立。 在 Qwen 3 上该比率是 52.57% 比 73.33%，在 10 个模型-模式中有 4 个超过一半。 这部分差距在完全没有冲突的情况下也存在。 单独询问时，用户指令行比由工具返回的同一行更常被执行，差距为 0.07% 到 25.44%，区间大于零的情况在 26 个模型-模式中有 23 个。

paragraphs.en: The penalty is in tool calls and file writes. In tool and file-write tasks the real role loses to the label by 6.41 to 48.75%, with the interval below zero in 26 of 26 model-modes, gpt-oss included. In format tasks no model-mode has its interval below zero (0 of 26). There it barely differs from the label on Qwen 3 ( − - 3.95 to + + 2.72%) and gains, with the interval above zero, in 4 model-modes, among them both gpt-oss models ( + + 11.29 to + + 13.86%). In order and refusal tasks the real role loses on Qwen (below zero in 8 of 10 Qwen 3 and 12 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes) but gains 19.27 to 25.52% on gpt-oss. On gpt-oss the gain in order and refusal tasks and the loss in tool and file-write tasks largely cancel at the first position.
paragraphs.zh: 惩罚体现在工具调用和文件写入上。 在工具和文件写入任务中，真实角色相比标签落后 6.41% 到 48.75%，在全部 26 个模型-模式中区间均低于零，包括 gpt-oss。 在格式任务中，没有任何模型-模式的区间低于零（26 个中有 0 个）。 在格式任务中，它在 Qwen 3 上与标签几乎无差异（-3.95% 到 +2.72%），并在 4 个模型-模式中获得提升，区间高于零，其中包括两个 gpt-oss 模型（+11.29% 到 +13.86%）。 在顺序和拒答任务中，真实角色在 Qwen 上落后（Qwen 3 的 10 个模型-模式中有 8 个、Qwen 3.5 的 14 个模型-模式中有 12 个区间低于零），但在 gpt-oss 上提升 19.27% 到 25.52%。 在 gpt-oss 上，顺序和拒答任务的提升与工具和文件写入任务的落后在第一位上大致相互抵消。

paragraphs.en: Sending the real operator last helps it. Sent last instead of first, the real operator gains 19.79 to 48.22% on Qwen 3 and 12.49 to 20.41% on gpt-oss. The gain holds on both halves in 10 of 10 and 2 of 2 model-modes. On Qwen 3 the late real operator wins 33.16 to 69.17%. At the last position the label still beats the real role in 6 of 10 Qwen 3 model-modes, with a range of − - 17.42 to + + 2.71% against − - 38.14 to − - 5.07% at the first position. On gpt-oss the late developer message beats the late label by 25.09 to 32.91%, so there the role has an effect that the label alone does not. Moving the labelled text last does not help gpt-oss (its win rate changes by − - 16.13 to − - 2.38%), so a late position helps the gpt-oss operator only through the real role. Qwen 3.5 has no late system layout, since its template rejects a system message after the first.
paragraphs.zh: 把真实操作员放在最后有助于其表现。 与放在开头相比，真实操作员放在最后时，在 Qwen 3 上提升 19.79 至 48.22%，在 gpt-oss 上提升 12.49 至 20.41%。 该提升在 10 个中的 10 个以及 2 个中的 2 个模型-模式的两半上均成立。 在 Qwen 3 上，靠后的真实操作员以 33.16 至 69.17% 获胜。 在最后位置，标签在 10 个 Qwen 3 模型-模式中的 6 个上仍胜过真实角色，其区间为 −17.42 至 +2.71%，而第一位置的区间为 −38.14 至 −5.07%。 在 gpt-oss 上，靠后的开发者消息以 25.09 至 32.91% 胜过靠后的标签，因此在该模型上角色具有单独标签所不具备的效果。 把带标签的文本移到最后对 gpt-oss 没有帮助（其胜率变化为 −16.13 至 −2.38%），因此靠后位置仅通过真实角色对 gpt-oss 操作员有帮助。 Qwen 3.5 没有靠后的系统布局，因为其模板拒绝在第一条之后出现系统消息。

paragraphs.en: Inside one message the first line wins. With the user line and the memory note inside the task’s message, the first-listed wins 72.42 to 94.66% of decided replies, with the interval above one half in 26 of 26 model-modes. paragraphs.en: The Context set places each instruction of 50 tool and file-write scenarios inside written text: an operator prompt of about 200 words, a user request, a repository file returned by config_read as the tool result \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4, and a page of saved notes (Appendix D ). Each item is sent bare and in context with the same options and seats, so every difference is paired within the item. The texts change more than realism: they add length and surrounding sentences, and some mention other documents or approvals, so these results describe the written texts rather than realism alone. Table 16 gives every model-mode.
paragraphs.zh: Context 集将 50 个工具和文件写入场景中的每条指令置于书面文本之内：一段约 200 词的操作者提示词、一条用户请求、一个由 config_read 作为工具结果 \seatchip seatFourFillseatFourLineS4 返回的仓库文件，以及一页保存的笔记（附录 D）。 每个条目都以裸形式和上下文形式发送，选项和席位相同，因此每个差异都在条目内部成对比较。 这些文本改变的不只是真实性：它们增加了篇幅和上下文句子，其中一些还提到其他文档或批准事项，因此这些结果描述的是书面文本本身，而不仅仅是真实性。 表 16 给出了所有模型-模式组合。

paragraphs.en: Context weakens a strong operator. Inside realistic text the operator sent first falls by 15.12 to 29.77% on gpt-oss, with both intervals below zero. On gpt-oss the operator wins 75.71 to 85.03% bare and 45.79 to 70.05% in context. On Qwen 3.5 with thinking off the operator falls, with the interval below zero, at 4 of 7 sizes, most in the 27B and the 122B-A10B ( − - 33.88%, − - 32.01%). On Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, for instance, the operator falls from 47.39% to 15.38%. Across Qwen 3.5 the operator falls with the interval below zero in 5 of 14 model-modes and gains, with the interval above zero, in 3, all with thinking on. Where the bare operator is weak, context can help it. On Qwen 3 it starts at 2.10 to 20.19% and gains in 5 of 10 model-modes. One possible reading of the losses is that in context the policy is one sentence in the middle of a long operator prompt instead of standing alone at the top of the system message, although the rival lines are placed inside text too.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文会削弱强算子。 在真实文本中，最先发出的算子在 gpt-oss 上下降 15.12 至 29.77%，且两个区间均低于零。 在 gpt-oss 上，该算子单独使用时胜率为 75.71 至 85.03%，在上下文中为 45.79 至 70.05%。 在关闭思考的 Qwen 3.5 上，该算子在 7 个规模中的 4 个上下降且区间低于零，主要集中在 27B 和 122B-A10B（−33.88%、−32.01%）。 例如在 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上，该算子从 47.39% 下降到 15.38%。 在整个 Qwen 3.5 上，该算子在 14 个模型-模式中的 5 个上下降且区间低于零，在 3 个上上升且区间高于零，且这 3 个全部开启了思考。 在单独算子较弱的地方，上下文可以帮助它。 在 Qwen 3 上，它起始于 2.10 至 20.19%，并在 10 个模型-模式中的 5 个上获得提升。 对这些损失的一种可能解读是，在上下文中，策略是长算子提示中间的一句话，而不是单独位于系统消息的顶部，尽管对手的行同样被置于文本之中。

sents.en: Context weakens a strong operator.
sents.zh: 上下文会削弱强算子。

sents.en: Inside realistic text the operator sent first falls by 15.12 to 29.77% on gpt-oss, with both intervals below zero.
sents.zh: 在真实文本中，最先发出的算子在 gpt-oss 上下降 15.12 至 29.77%，且两个区间均低于零。

sents.en: On gpt-oss the operator wins 75.71 to 85.03% bare and 45.79 to 70.05% in context.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss 上，该算子单独使用时胜率为 75.71 至 85.03%，在上下文中为 45.79 至 70.05%。

sents.en: On Qwen 3.5 with thinking off the operator falls, with the interval below zero, at 4 of 7 sizes, most in the 27B and the 122B-A10B ( − - 33.88%, − - 32.01%).
sents.zh: 在关闭思考的 Qwen 3.5 上，该算子在 7 个规模中的 4 个上下降且区间低于零，主要集中在 27B 和 122B-A10B（−33.88%、−32.01%）。

sents.en: On Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, for instance, the operator falls from 47.39% to 15.38%.
sents.zh: 例如在 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上，该算子从 47.39% 下降到 15.38%。

sents.en: Across Qwen 3.5 the operator falls with the interval below zero in 5 of 14 model-modes and gains, with the interval above zero, in 3, all with thinking on.
sents.zh: 在整个 Qwen 3.5 上，该算子在 14 个模型-模式中的 5 个上下降且区间低于零，在 3 个上上升且区间高于零，且这 3 个全部开启了思考。

sents.en: Where the bare operator is weak, context can help it.
sents.zh: 在单独算子较弱的地方，上下文可以帮助它。

sents.en: On Qwen 3 it starts at 2.10 to 20.19% and gains in 5 of 10 model-modes.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen 3 上，它起始于 2.10 至 20.19%，并在 10 个模型-模式中的 5 个上获得提升。

sents.en: One possible reading of the losses is that in context the policy is one sentence in the middle of a long operator prompt instead of standing alone at the top of the system message, although the rival lines are placed inside text too.
sents.zh: 对这些损失的一种可能解读是，在上下文中，策略是长算子提示中间的一句话，而不是单独位于系统消息的顶部，尽管对手的行同样被置于文本之中。

paragraphs.en: The later line wins in context. In context the later line wins more than half the time, with the interval above 50%, in 25 of 26 model-modes, and context changes its rate by − - 10.05 to + + 24.56%. On gpt-oss context raises recency by 10.02 to 11.95%. On Qwen 3.5 with thinking off recency rises most on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, by + + 24.56%, one of the two models whose operator fell most. In context these models lean more on position and less on the operator’s seat. Over all model-modes the change goes both ways: up in 10 and down in 6 of 26.
paragraphs.zh: 在上下文中，后一行胜出。 在上下文中，后一行胜出的时间超过一半，在26个模型-模式中有25个区间高于50%，且上下文使其比率变化为−10.05%至+24.56%。 在gpt-oss上，上下文使近因效应提高10.02%至11.95%。 在关闭思考模式的Qwen 3.5上，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B的近因效应上升最多，为+24.56%，它是算子下降最多的两个模型之一。 在上下文中，这些模型更依赖位置，而更少依赖算子的席位。 在所有模型-模式中，变化是双向的：26个中有10个上升，6个下降。

paragraphs.en: Knowing where the task line is helps every forecast. The task-aware fit beats the position fit in 26 of 26 model-modes, by 0.012 to 0.113 nats per reply, with the interval above zero in each. The gain is + + 0.029 to + + 0.102 nats on Qwen 3, + + 0.019 to + + 0.113 on Qwen 3.5 and + + 0.012 to + + 0.016 on gpt-oss, and it holds on both halves (Table 9 ). Of the five fits in Table 17 , it has the best log score in the most model-modes (bold). Adding seat strengths to it, as in Section 4.4 , improves it further, with the interval above zero, in 15 of 26 model-modes; that fit is not in the table. On Qwen 3 the task-aware fit’s share of the gap is 60.08 to 75.81%, against 49.86 to 61.77% for the position fit. The task-line term was found on Qwen 3 and applied unchanged to the other two families.
paragraphs.zh: 知道任务线在哪里有助于每一次预测。 任务感知拟合在 26 个模型-模式中的 26 个里都优于位置拟合，优势为每条回复 0.012 到 0.113 nats，且每个情形下区间都在零以上。 在 Qwen 3 上的增益为 + + 0.029 到 + + 0.102 nats，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 + + 0.019 到 + + 0.113，在 gpt-oss 上为 + + 0.012 到 + + 0.016，且在两个半区上都成立（表 9）。 在表 17 的五种拟合中，它在最多的模型-模式下拥有最佳的对数得分（加粗）。 如第 4.4 节那样，在其基础上加入座位强度可以进一步改进它，在 26 个模型-模式中的 15 个里区间在零以上；该拟合未列入表中。 在 Qwen 3 上，任务感知拟合对差距的解释份额为 60.08 到 75.81%，而位置拟合为 49.86 到 61.77%。 任务线项是在 Qwen 3 上发现的，并原封不动地应用于另外两个家族。

On Qwen 3 the gain is − - 0.020 to + + 0.051 nats. It is above zero in 3 model-modes, all with thinking on, and below zero in 3. Fitted on one half and scored on the other, the gain on Qwen 3.5 stays at − - 0.007 to + + 0.142 and − - 0.019 to + + 0.136 nats in the two directions.
paragraphs.zh: 座位强度在 Qwen 3.5 和 gpt-oss 上有帮助。 在 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型模式中的 10 个和 2 个 gpt-oss 模型模式中的 2 个里，座位拟合优于位置拟合，区间高于零，最多高出 + + 0.139 nats 每次回复。 在 Qwen 3 上，增益为 − - 0.020 到 + + 0.051 nats。 它在 3 个模型模式中高于零，全部开启了思考，在 3 个中低于零。 在一半数据上拟合、在另一半上评分时，Qwen 3.5 的增益在两个方向上分别为 − - 0.007 到 + + 0.142 和 − - 0.019 到 + + 0.136 nats。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen 3, position picks nearly as many winners as the reference. On Qwen 3 the position fit ranks the right winner first in 47.60 to 69.70% of replies, close to the reference’s 50.57 to 69.70%. The position fit recovers 49.86 to 61.77% of the gap on Qwen 3, against 4.69 to 49.88% on Qwen 3.5 and 0.90 to 26.71% on gpt-oss. Fitted on one half and scored on the other, its share on Qwen 3 stays at 43.43 to 55.72% and 49.44 to 62.01%. The reference itself names the winner in only 44.44 to 69.70% of replies across model-modes. For the same set and order, outcomes vary across scenarios, task-line places and draws, and no forecast that knows only the set and the order can remove that variation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen 3 上，位置选取选出的胜者数量几乎与参照标准相当。 在 Qwen 3 上，位置拟合在 47.60% 至 69.70% 的回复中将正确的胜者排在第一位，接近参照标准的 50.57% 至 69.70%。 位置拟合在 Qwen 3 上可挽回 49.86% 至 61.77% 的差距，而在 Qwen 3.5 上为 4.69% 至 49.88%，在 gpt-oss 上为 0.90% 至 26.71%。 在一半数据上拟合并对另一半数据评分时，其在 Qwen 3 上的占比保持在 43.43% 至 55.72% 和 49.44% 至 62.01%。 参照标准本身在各模型-模式下也只有 44.44% 至 69.70% 的回复中点名了胜者。 对于相同的集合和顺序，结果在不同场景、任务线位置和平局之间各有不同，任何只知道集合和顺序的预测都无法消除这种差异。

paragraphs.en: This section tests the seats fit of Section 4.4 on the Agreement sets (Section 3.3 ). In each Agreement trial the seats form two camps that ask for two different options: two against one, two against two, three against one, three against two or four against one (Appendix D ). The seats fit, fitted on the Ladder pairs, predicts how often the larger camp’s option, the shared option, wins, by summing the forecast chances of the seats in that camp. Sets of two against two have no larger camp and are left out. No Agreement reply enters any fit, so Table 19 is an out-of-sample test.
paragraphs.zh: 本节测试第 4.4 节的席位拟合在 Agreement 集合（第 3.3 节）上的表现。 在每次 Agreement 试验中，席位形成要求两个不同选项的两个阵营：二对一、二对二、三对一、三对二或四对一（附录 D）。 在 Ladder 配对上拟合的席位拟合，通过将该阵营中各席位的预测胜率相加，来预测较大阵营的选项（即共享选项）获胜的频率。 二对二的集合没有较大阵营，因此被排除在外。 任何 Agreement 回复都不进入任何拟合，因此表 19 是一次样本外测试。

paragraphs.en: Agreement adds a little, mostly on Qwen 3.5. The shared option wins more often than the seats fit predicts in 9 of 14 Qwen 3.5 model-modes, by at most + + 5.41%. Of these, 5 hold on both halves. On Qwen 3 the gap is − - 2.68 to + + 6.85%, above the prediction in 4 model-modes and below it in 2. On gpt-oss the observed share matches the prediction ( − - 1.09 to − - 0.56%).
paragraphs.zh: 共识的增益很小，主要体现在 Qwen 3.5 上。 在 14 个 Qwen 3.5 模型模式中有 9 个里，共享选项的获胜率高于席位拟合的预测，最大差距为 + + 5.41%。 其中 5 个在两半数据上都成立。 在 Qwen 3 上，差距为 − - 2.68 到 + + 6.85%，有 4 个模型模式高于预测，2 个低于预测。 在 gpt-oss 上，观察到的份额与预测相符（ − - 1.09 到 − - 0.56%）。

paragraphs.en: Agreeing seats beat the seats fit in 13 of 26 model-modes. Across all 26 model-modes, the observed share of the shared option minus the predicted share is − - 2.68 to + + 6.85%, above zero in 13 and below zero in 2. The predicted share hardly varies across models, because the groupings spread seats and options widely and the fitted effects largely average out. Over all usable replies the observed share falls below the prediction in most model-modes (last column of Table 19 ), so Agreement trials end with no single winner more often than the pairs predict.
paragraphs.zh: 在 26 个模型模式中，有 13 个的「一致席位数」高于「席位匹配数」。 在全部 26 个模型模式中，「共享选项」的观测占比减去预测占比的差值介于 −2.68% 到 +6.85% 之间，其中 13 个高于零，2 个低于零。 各模型间的预测占比几乎没有变化，因为分组使席位和选项分布广泛，而拟合效应大体相互抵消。 在所有可用回复中，大多数模型模式下观测占比低于预测值（表 19 最后一列），因此「一致试验」以没有单一胜者告终的频率高于「成对试验」所预测的水平。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen 3.5 the gain survives strict counting. With every reply counted and a cut-off or unusable reply as a failure, thinking still raises tier following at 6 of 7 Qwen 3.5 sizes (all seven: + + 1.48 to + + 15.43%). We run this check because thinking adds cut-offs on Qwen 3.5, where their share of Ladder conflict replies rises at 7 of 7 sizes, by up to + + 7.98%. On Qwen 3 thinking barely moves the cut-off share ( − - 0.17 to + + 0.26%), and the strict count keeps the gain at 2 of the 3 sizes from 4B up. At Qwen3-14B it turns to − - 4.85%. There, thinking adds replies that choose no option, so the gain on decided replies does not carry over to every reply.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen 3.5 上，这一增益在严格计数下依然存在。 在统计每一条回复、并将截断或不可用回复计为失败的情况下，思考模式仍在 7 个 Qwen 3.5 规模中的 6 个上提升层级跟进率（全部七个：+ + 1.48 至 + + 15.43%）。 我们进行这项检验，是因为思考模式在 Qwen 3.5 上会增加截断，其占 Ladder 冲突回复的比例在 7 个规模中的 7 个上均上升，最高达 + + 7.98%。 在 Qwen 3 上，思考模式几乎不改变截断比例（− - 0.17 至 + + 0.26%），且严格计数使该增益在 4B 及以上的 3 个规模中的 2 个上得以保持。 在 Qwen3-14B 上则变为 − - 4.85%。 在那里，思考模式会添加不选择任何选项的回复，因此在已决回复上的增益无法延续到所有回复。

paragraphs.en: Thinking moves system-message following both ways. Thinking raises operator wins in the real system message at 4 of 5 Qwen 3 sizes and lowers them at 5 of 7 Qwen 3.5 sizes. The change is + + 1.07 to + + 12.94% on Qwen 3, on both halves at 4 sizes, and − - 12.78 to + + 2.09% on Qwen 3.5, on both halves at 2. Counting every reply widens the Qwen 3.5 drop to 6 of 7 sizes (all seven: − - 11.42 to − - 0.49%). Operator wins in the Ladder pairs, where the operator line always comes first, agree in direction: up at 3 of 5 Qwen 3 sizes and down at 3 of 7 Qwen 3.5 sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 思维（Thinking）使系统消息的跟随向两个方向移动。 思维在 5 个 Qwen 3 尺寸中的 4 个上提高了真实系统消息中的智能体胜率，而在 7 个 Qwen 3.5 尺寸中的 5 个上降低了该胜率。 变化幅度在 Qwen 3 上为 +1.07% 到 +12.94%，其中 4 个尺寸在两半上均为正；在 Qwen 3.5 上为 −12.78% 到 +2.09%，其中 2 个尺寸在两半上方向一致。 统计每条回复会将 Qwen 3.5 的下降扩大到 7 个尺寸中的 6 个（全部七个：−11.42% 到 −0.49%）。 在 Ladder 配对中（操作者一行总是排在前面），操作者的胜率方向一致：Qwen 3 的 5 个尺寸中有 3 个上升，Qwen 3.5 的 7 个尺寸中有 3 个下降。

paragraphs.en: In each Tiers trial two options carry a declared priority from 1 to 6 under a system rule that the lower number wins (Box 4 in Appendix B ). Table 21 gives how often the rule is followed, overall and by the gap between the two tiers, and a bound on how many tiers a model keeps in order.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个 Tiers 试验中，两个选项在系统规则下带有 1 到 6 的声明优先级，规则规定数字越小者胜（附录 B 的框 4）。 表 21 给出了该规则被遵循的频率（包括总体情况和按两个层级之间差距划分的情况），以及模型保持在有序状态内的层级数量的界限。

sents.zh: 在每个 Tiers 试验中，两个选项在系统规则下带有 1 到 6 的声明优先级，规则规定数字越小者胜（附录 B 的框 4）。

sents.en: Table 21 gives how often the rule is followed, overall and by the gap between the two tiers, and a bound on how many tiers a model keeps in order.
sents.zh: 表 21 给出了该规则被遵循的频率（包括总体情况和按两个层级之间差距划分的情况），以及模型保持在有序状态内的层级数量的界限。

paragraphs.en: The declared rule is followed more often than not. The lower tier wins with the interval above one half in 24 of 26 model-modes (all 26: 50.78 to 98.51%). Within each Qwen family the rate mostly rises with size (51.32 to 77.41% on Qwen 3, 50.78 to 98.51% on Qwen 3.5), but the dense Qwen3.5-27B beats both larger mixture-of-experts models; gpt-oss is at 91.54 to 94.26%. The two exceptions are the smallest model of each Qwen family with thinking off. Over all usable replies the rates fall to 24.29 to 87.08%. gpt-oss-20b falls furthest, from 91.54% to 47.89%, partly because it often takes no action instead of choosing (Appendix N ).
paragraphs.zh: 声明的规则在多数情况下会被遵循。 在 26 个模型-模式中有 24 个里，较低层级以上半数区间的胜出（全部 26 个：50.78% 至 98.51%）。 在 Qwen 家族内部，该比率大多随规模上升（Qwen 3 上为 51.32% 至 77.41%，Qwen 3.5 上为 50.78% 至 98.51%），但稠密的 Qwen3.5-27B 击败了两个更大的混合专家模型；gpt-oss 为 91.54% 至 94.26%。 两个例外是各 Qwen 家族中关闭思考功能的 smallest 模型。 在所有可用回复中，该比率降至 24.29% 至 87.08%。gpt-oss-20b 降幅最大，从 91.54% 降至 47.89%，部分原因是它常常不采取任何行动而非进行选择（附录 N）。

paragraphs.en: The gap matters little once the winning tier is fixed. A joint fit on the tier gap and the winning tier gives − - 1.38 to + + 2.05% per step of gap, with the interval above zero in 3 of 26 model-modes. The per-gap columns of Table 21 rise with the gap in many model-modes. In this design the gap and the winning tier move together: the only pair five steps apart is tier 1 against tier 6, so a large gap always has its winner near the top. With the winning tier held fixed, much of the rise disappears, which means it comes mostly from which tiers are in the pair and little from how far apart they are.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦获胜层固定，差距的影响就很小。 对层差距与获胜层的联合拟合给出每一步差距 − - 1.38 到 + + 2.05%，且在 26 个模型-模式中有 3 个区间高于零。 表 21 中每差距列在许多模型-模式中随差距上升。 在此设计中，差距与获胜层是共同变化的：唯一相距五步的配对是层 1 对层 6，因此大差距的获胜者总是靠近顶端。 在固定获胜层后，大部分上升消失了，这意味着上升主要来自配对中包含哪些层，而很少来自它们相距多远。

paragraphs.en: No model keeps even two tiers in order at reliability 0.95. The upper bound on R ⁡ ( 0.95 ) R(0.95) is 1 tier in every one of the 26 model-modes. R ⁡ ( q ) R(q) is the size of the largest set of tiers whose every pair the model follows with probability above q q . We bound it with exact binomial intervals on one draw per scenario and tier pair, Bonferroni-corrected over the 15 tier pairs. A usable reply counts as following the rule only when it chose the winning tier’s option, so a reply with no action or an off-menu answer counts against it. An upper bound of one tier means every pair of tiers is ruled out at 0.95. Qwen3.5-27B with thinking on follows the rule in 98.51% of decided replies, yet in only 87.08% of usable ones.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何模型在可靠性 0.95 下能保持哪怕两层有序。 在全部 26 个模型-模式中，R(0.95) 的上界都是 1 层。 R(q) 是最大的一组层的数量，其中每一对层模型都以高于 q 的概率遵循。 我们在每个场景与层对上各抽取一次，用精确二项区间进行界定，并在 15 个层对上做 Bonferroni 校正。 一个可用的回复只有在选中获胜层对应的选项时才算遵循规则，因此没有行动或给出菜单外答案的回复都算作不遵循。 上界为 1 层意味着每一对层都在 0.95 下被排除。 Qwen3.5-27B 开启思考后在已判定的回复中有 98.51% 遵循规则，但在可用回复中只有 87.08%。

sents.en: A usable reply counts as following the rule only when it chose the winning tier’s option, so a reply with no action or an off-menu answer counts against it.
sents.zh: 一个可用的回复只有在选中获胜层对应的选项时才算遵循规则，因此没有行动或给出菜单外答案的回复都算作不遵循。

sents.en: An upper bound of one tier means every pair of tiers is ruled out at 0.95.
sents.zh: 上界为 1 层意味着每一对层都在 0.95 下被排除。

sents.en: Qwen3.5-27B with thinking on follows the rule in 98.51% of decided replies, yet in only 87.08% of usable ones.
sents.zh: Qwen3.5-27B 开启思考后在已判定的回复中有 98.51% 遵循规则，但在可用回复中只有 87.08%。

paragraphs.en: This section shows what every reply did and how each rate of Section 3.4 treats it.
paragraphs.zh: 本节展示了每条回复所做的工作，以及第 3.4 节中的每种速率是如何处理它的。

paragraphs.en: Table 22 and Figure 8 split the usable Ladder conflict replies into the five outcomes of Appendix A . A rate over decided replies uses only replies that chose an option exactly one seat asked for (any seat in the Agreement sets). Replies with any other outcome are left out of that rate. The columns marked “all usable” (Tables 11 , 19 and 21 ) count every other usable reply as a loss for both sides.
paragraphs.zh: 表 22 和图 8 将可用的 Ladder 冲突回复划分为附录 A 中的五种结果。 「已定回复比率」仅统计那些恰好选择了某个席位所要求的选项的回复（协议集合中的任意席位）。 具有其他结果的回复不计入该比率。 标记为「所有可用」（表 11、19 和 21）的列将其他所有可用回复计为双方的失利。

paragraphs.en: gpt-oss often takes no action. gpt-oss takes no action in 17.64 to 23.40% of its usable replies across all experiments except Load, most often to ask for missing content (Box 5), against 0.38% and 1.79% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. Such a reply never makes the call the task is scored on, so it is never decided. Among the Qwen models only the smallest take no action about as often (Qwen3-0.6B 21.37% and 31.59% with thinking off and on, Qwen3.5-0.8B 14.30% and 18.11%). A rate over decided replies therefore describes what gpt-oss does when it acts, and an all-usable rate describes what it does per request. On the second reading gpt-oss-120b still follows the operator line sent first in the Ladder 51.03% of the time, above Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (29.64% and 30.51%), while gpt-oss-20b falls to 34.57%. Section 4.2 gives both readings for gpt-oss-120b.
paragraphs.zh: gpt-oss 经常不采取行动。在除 Load 之外的所有实验中，gpt-oss 在其可用回复中有 17.64% 到 23.40% 不采取行动，最常见的原因是询问缺失的内容（Box 5），而 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的这一比例分别为 0.38% 和 1.79%。 这种回复永远不会执行作为评分依据的调用，因此永远不会被判定。 在 Qwen 系列模型中，只有最小的几个模型不采取行动的频率与之相当（Qwen3-0.6B 在关闭和开启思考模式时分别为 21.37% 和 31.59%，Qwen3.5-0.8B 分别为 14.30% 和 18.11%）。 因此，基于已判定回复的比率描述的是 gpt-oss 在采取行动时的行为，而基于全部可用回复的比率描述的是它在每次请求中的行为。 在第二次阅读时，gpt-oss-120b 仍有 51.03% 的情况下遵循在 Ladder 中最先发送的运营商指令，高于 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B（29.64% 和 30.51%），而 gpt-oss-20b 则降至 34.57%。 第 4.2 节给出了 gpt-oss-120b 的两种读数。

paragraphs.en: Few replies leave the menu. Off-menu answers make up 1.56 to 7.32% of usable Ladder conflict replies, and cut-offs 0.03 to 9.03% of all replies. Two answers in one reply ( multiple ) are rarer still. The largest undecided outcome is unresolved , an artifact that no checker could label, in every model-mode except gpt-oss-20b, where no action is larger. Cut-offs gather in the small Qwen 3.5 models with thinking on (Appendix L ). The rates leave them out, except the strict counts of Appendix L , which count them as failures.
paragraphs.zh: 很少有回复脱离菜单。 菜单外回答占可用 Ladder 冲突回复的 1.56% 至 7.32%，截断占全部回复的 0.03% 至 9.03%。 一次回复中出现两个答案（多重）更为罕见。 最大的未决结果是未解决，这是一个没有任何检查器能够标注的产物，在每个模型-模式中都是如此，唯独 gpt-oss-20b 例外，在该模型中没有任何动作更大。 截断集中在开启思考模式的小型 Qwen 3.5 模型中（附录 L）。 各项比率均未将它们计入，只有附录 L 的严格计数将它们计为失败。

paragraphs.en: Models rarely name the conflict. Only 0.14 to 2.92% of decided Ladder pair replies flag or hedge the conflict. gpt-oss flags most (2.14 to 2.92%); Qwen 3 flags in 0.14 to 1.38% and Qwen 3.5 in 0.22 to 1.69%. A model can name a conflict and still follow either line, so flagging is scored apart from the choice (Table 23 ).
paragraphs.zh: 模型很少明确指出冲突。 在已决出的 Ladder 成对回复中，只有 0.14% 到 2.92% 会标记或回避该冲突。gpt-oss 标记最多（2.14% 到 2.92%）；Qwen 3 在 0.14% 到 1.38% 的情况下标记，Qwen 3.5 在 0.22% 到 1.69% 的情况下标记。 智能体可以在指出冲突的同时仍然遵循其中任何一条路线，因此标记与选择分开计分（表 23）。

sents.en: Models rarely name the conflict.
sents.zh: 模型很少明确指出冲突。

sents.en: Only 0.14 to 2.92% of decided Ladder pair replies flag or hedge the conflict. gpt-oss flags most (2.14 to 2.92%); Qwen 3 flags in 0.14 to 1.38% and Qwen 3.5 in 0.22 to 1.69%.

paragraphs.en: In Qwen, flagged replies favour the earlier line more than silent ones. When a Qwen reply flags the conflict, the earlier line wins more often than when it stays silent, by + + 20.03% [8.62, 33.35] on Qwen 3 and + + 15.65% [5.47, 26.43] on Qwen 3.5, pooled per family. On gpt-oss the difference is + + 7.77% [ − - 3.92, 18.76], and its earlier line already wins often in silent replies. The comparison is unpaired, so it shows only an association: Qwen replies that name the conflict follow the later line less often.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen 中，被标记冲突的回复比沉默的回复更偏向较早的那一行。 当 Qwen 的回复标出冲突时，较早的那一行比它保持沉默时更常胜出，按每个系列汇总，Qwen 3 上高 +20.03% [8.62, 33.35]，Qwen 3.5 上高 +15.65% [5.47, 26.43]。 在 gpt-oss 上，这一差异为 +7.77% [−3.92, 18.76]，而其较早的那一行在沉默回复中本就经常胜出。 这一比较是非配对的，因此它只显示一种关联：指出冲突的 Qwen 回复更少遵循较晚的那一行。

sents.zh: 在 Qwen 中，被标记冲突的回复比沉默的回复更偏向较早的那一行。

paragraphs.en: Boxes 5 to 7 show three scored replies, trimmed where marked. Box 5 is a reply that takes no action and asks a question back, Box 6 a reply that names the conflict, and Box 7 a thinking trace that applies a declared tier rule.
paragraphs.zh: 方框 5 至 7 展示了三个已评分的回复，并在标记处进行了裁剪。 方框 5 是一个不采取行动而反问一个问题的回复，方框 6 是一个指明冲突的回复，方框 7 是一个应用了已声明层级规则的思考轨迹。

sents.zh: 方框 5 至 7 展示了三个已评分的回复，并在标记处进行了裁剪。

paragraphs.en: Each of ten written bundles puts n ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 12 } n\in\{2,4,8,12\} instructions in the operator message, with the task as a user message and k k conflict groups among the instructions. Filler lines keep the list the same length in Qwen tokens at each n n (Appendix D ). The measure is the share of tool and file-write conflict groups in which the reply chose one of the group’s options. Format groups are left out, because a format option that matches the model’s usual habit counts as chosen even when the line was not read. Intervals are clustered by bundle.
paragraphs.zh: 十个书面任务包中的每一个都在操作员消息中放入 n∈{2,4,8,12} 条指令，任务作为用户消息，指令中包含 k 个冲突组。 填充行使列表在每个 n 下按 Qwen 词元计的长度保持一致（附录 D）。 度量指标是智能体在工具和文件写入冲突组中选择组内某一选项的比例。 格式组被排除在外，因为即使该行未被读取，符合模型通常习惯的格式选项也会被计为已选择。 区间按任务包进行聚类。

sents.zh: 区间按任务包进行聚类。

paragraphs.en: More conflicts at a fixed length have no steady cost. Pooled per family, going from one to three conflict groups among eight instructions changes the share chosen by − - 3.98% [ − - 12.80, 5.00] on Qwen 3, − - 1.03% [ − - 6.90, 4.71] on Qwen 3.5 and − - 8.77% [ − - 18.32, 0.57] on gpt-oss. Every one of these intervals spans zero. Per model-mode several intervals exclude zero, most of them below zero (Table 24 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在固定长度下，更多的冲突并没有稳定的代价。 按家族合并来看，在八条指令中从一个冲突组增加到三个冲突组，所选份额的变化在 Qwen 3 上为 -3.98% [-12.80, 5.00]，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 -1.03% [-6.90, 4.71]，在 gpt-oss 上为 -8.77% [-18.32, 0.57]。 这些区间中的每一个都跨越零。 在每个模型-模式下，有几个区间不包含零，其中大多数低于零（表 24）。

sents.en: More conflicts at a fixed length have no steady cost.
sents.zh: 在固定长度下，更多的冲突并没有稳定的代价。

paragraphs.en: Instruction count has no common direction. At one conflict, twelve instructions instead of two change the share chosen by + + 9.59% [ − - 0.37, 20.55] on Qwen 3, − - 17.64% [ − - 29.15, − - 7.08] on Qwen 3.5 and + + 1.40% [ − - 15.04, 15.52] on gpt-oss. We compare counts at one conflict because at k = 0 k=0 there is no conflict group to score. The Qwen 3 rise comes from thinking on. The Qwen 3.5 drop comes mostly from thinking off and from the twelve-line layout with a single conflict. In the same family, putting six conflicts into the same twelve lines raises the share chosen over one conflict (pooled + + 11.78% [3.42, 23.50]), so the low value is specific to that one layout.
paragraphs.zh: 指令数量没有共同方向。 在一个冲突场景中，两条指令变为十二条指令时，被选择份额的变化在 Qwen 3 上为 +9.59% [−0.37, 20.55]，在 Qwen 3.5 上为 −17.64% [−29.15, −7.08]，在 gpt-oss 上为 +1.40% [−15.04, 15.52]。 我们只在一个冲突场景下比较数量，因为在 k = 0 时没有可供打分的冲突组。 Qwen 3 的上升来自开启思考模式。 Qwen 3.5 的下降主要来自关闭思考模式，以及仅含单个冲突的十二行布局。 在同一模型家族中，把六个冲突放入同样的十二行会使被选择份额高于单个冲突的情况（合并后 +11.78% [3.42, 23.50]），因此该低值是这一特定布局所独有的。

paragraphs.en: This section describes what is public and how the numbers in the paper can be rebuilt, then shows how to install and use the code.
paragraphs.zh: 本节描述哪些内容是公开的，以及如何重现论文中的数字结果，然后介绍如何安装和使用代码。

paragraphs.en: The repository at https://github.com/anishh15/WhoWins holds the 1,080 scenarios with all their items, the code that builds each trial, the checkers and the analyses of single runs. The items include the Context texts and the Load bundles. The code covers the checkers and format classifiers, with the adversarial replies that test them, and the check, described in Appendix B , that each layout reaches every family unchanged. The repository also holds the configuration of every run (the models with their pinned weight revisions, the vLLM serve files and the sampling settings), the frozen split lists, the tests and the authoring guides of Appendix C . The Python package whowins ( https://pypi.org/project/whowins/ ) carries the same code, scenarios and run configurations, and the website https://anishh15.github.io/WhoWins/ shows the main results and every scenario. The 1,887,356 scored replies, with the requests that produced them, will be released separately.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库 https://github.com/anishh15/WhoWins 保存了这 1,080 个场景及其所有条目、构建每次试验的代码、检查器以及单次运行的分析。 这些条目包括 Context 文本和 Load 包。 代码涵盖检查器和格式分类器（包括用于测试它们的对抗性回复），以及附录 B 中描述的检查，即验证每种布局原封不动地到达每个族群。 该仓库还保存了每次运行的配置（模型及其锁定的权重修订版、vLLM serve 文件和采样设置）、冻结的划分列表、测试以及附录 C 的编写指南。 Python 包 whowins（https://pypi.org/project/whowins/）包含相同的代码、场景和运行配置，网站 https://anishh15.github.io/WhoWins/ 展示了主要结果和每个场景。 这 1,887,356 条已评分的回复以及产生它们的请求将单独发布。

paragraphs.en: Each model is used at one fixed revision of its published weights, with that revision’s chat template, and gpt-oss prompts are rendered with openai-harmony 0.0.8. Each request carries all its sampling settings and its own seed. Each design is built by code from the scenarios with no random step, and each draw’s seed derives from the run’s seed, the trial and the repeat (Appendix E ). The scored replies record the serving release and number format of each run (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型都在其已发布权重的固定修订版本上使用，使用该版本的聊天模板，gpt-oss 提示词则用 openai-harmony 0.0.8 渲染。 每个请求都携带全部采样设置及其自身的种子。 每个设计都由场景代码构建，不含任何随机步骤，且每次抽样的种子由运行的种子、试验与重复共同决定（附录 E）。 参与评分的回复记录了每次运行的服务发布版本与数字格式（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic checkers read the tool-call trace and the answer text, with no LLM judge, so scoring the same records twice gives the same result. The reasoning text is stored and never scored. Because the raw replies are kept, the scores can be rebuilt from the stored records at any time without querying a model again.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性检查器读取工具调用轨迹和答案文本，不使用 LLM 评判，因此对同一批记录评分两次会得到相同的结果。 推理文本会被存储，但从不参与评分。 由于保留了原始回复，随时可以基于存储的记录重新构建评分，而无需再次查询模型。

paragraphs.en: The public code builds every trial of every run from the scenarios, sends it to a served model and scores the reply, and it can score a run’s stored replies again. For one finished run it also reports the counts and rates of each outcome, the paired contrasts of the Operator, Boundary and Context layouts, how many declared tiers the model keeps in order, and fits of one strength per seat with their forecasts of the triples and the five-way set. The tables, figures and numbers of this paper come from separate aggregation scripts, which are not in the public repository. They pool these measures over the 26 model-modes and add the task-aware fit, the two halves of the scenarios, the 2,000-resample scenario bootstrap and the tests of Appendix F . They fit the choice models by maximum likelihood with the package’s own code, and they run on Python 3.11.8 with NumPy 2.4.0 and pandas 2.3.3. The held-out split is a fixed function of each scenario’s identifier and the bootstrap uses fixed seeds, so a rebuild gives the same estimates and the same intervals.
paragraphs.zh: 公开代码会根据场景构建每次运行的每个试验，将其发送到所服务的模型并对回复打分，还可以再次对某次运行存储的回复打分。 对于一次已完成的运行，它还会报告每种结果的计数和比率、Operator、Boundary 和 Context 布局的配对对比、模型按顺序保持的声明层级数量，以及每个席位一个强度的拟合及其对三元组和五向集合的预测。 本文的表格、图形和数字来自单独的汇总脚本，这些脚本不在公开代码库中。 它们将 26 种模型-模式下的这些度量汇总起来，并加入任务感知拟合、场景的两半、2,000 次重抽样的场景自助法以及附录 F 中的检验。 它们使用该软件包自带的代码通过最大似然法拟合选择模型，并在 Python 3.11.8、NumPy 2.4.0 和 pandas 2.3.3 环境下运行。 留出集划分是每个场景标识符的固定函数，自助法使用固定种子，因此重新构建会得到相同的估计值和相同的区间。

paragraphs.en: This section extends Section 2 and explains the entries of Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本节是对第 2 节的扩展，并解释表 1 中的各项内容。

paragraphs.en: Wallace et al. (2024) generate aligned and conflicting instructions and fine-tune GPT-3.5 Turbo to ignore lower-privileged instructions that conflict with higher ones. IH-Challenge is a reinforcement-learning dataset; fine-tuning GPT-5-Mini on it raises the average over 16 robustness benchmarks from 84.1% to 94.1% ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Zheng et al. (2026) treat hierarchy resolution as a reasoning task and train it with reinforcement learning on VerIH, a dataset of aligned and conflicting system–user constraints with verifiable answers. Other methods change the input encoding or the objective: segment embeddings that mark the priority of each input ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , a preference objective weighted by the distance between five levels, trained on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Bolliger and Jäger, 2026 ) , solver-guided resolution of conflicts as a constraint-satisfaction problem ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , and contrastive decoding against lower-priority roles in multi-turn conversations ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . A related line separates instructions from data: a formal separation score with the SEP dataset ( Zverev et al., 2025 ) , structured queries that carry data in a separate channel ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and a rotation of the embeddings of data tokens ( Zverev et al., 2026 ) . gpt-oss was post-trained with its harmony format to follow system over developer over user messages ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , and the format guide lists system, developer, user, assistant and tool as the order the model applies to conflicts ( Kundel, 2025 ) . These works install or enforce a ranking, whereas we measure which ranking a model already applies and how much of that ranking comes from position.

paragraphs.en: SysBench tests system-message following with 500 system messages and multi-turn conversations ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , and RealGuardrails builds test and fine-tuning data from real system prompts ( Mu et al., 2025 ) . IHEval has 3,538 examples over nine tasks and four input types, all scored by code; the best open model it tests resolves 48% of conflicts ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Control Illusion combines 100 tasks with six pairs of conflicting constraints, in both priority directions (1,200 prompts), and tests six models in three system–user layouts ( Geng et al., 2026 ) . IH-Benchmark has 2,336 scenarios from 44 constraint families, tests 37 model variants, and finds that strong system-over-user compliance does not predict robustness to conflicts in tool outputs ( McCauley et al., 2026 ) . ManyIH-Bench has 853 tasks with up to twelve tiers, and the best of 13 models reaches 42.7% ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . XIH-Bench crosses six languages with three hierarchy settings and finds higher compliance when the two conflicting instructions are in different languages ( Moon et al., 2026 ) . Kariyappa and Suh (2026) insert 0, 4 or 8 benign turns between the system instruction and the conflicting user message, and locate each failure in identifying, resolving or carrying out the instructions. Balp-Straffon et al. (2026) (Choose Sides in Table 1 ) use 41 constraint pairs with deterministic verifiers on eight models and sort the models into hierarchy, no-effect and anti-hierarchy groups. Most of these put each conflict between two levels. ManyIH tests many tiers, but as tags written in one message, so the tiers carry no chat role.
paragraphs.zh: SysBench 通过 500 条系统消息和多轮对话来测试系统消息遵循能力（Qin et al., 2024），RealGuardrails 则从真实的系统提示构建测试与微调数据（Mu et al., 2025）。 IHEVAL 包含覆盖九个任务和四种输入类型的 3,538 个示例，全部由代码评分；其测试的最佳开源模型仅能解决 48% 的冲突（Zhang et al., 2025）。 Control Illusion 将 100 个任务与六对冲突约束组合，涵盖两种优先级方向（1,200 条提示），并以三种系统–用户布局测试六个模型（Geng et al., 2026）。 IH-Benchmark 包含来自 44 个约束族的 2,336 个场景，测试了 37 个模型变体，并发现系统对用户的强依从性并不能预测其对工具输出中冲突的鲁棒性（McCauley et al., 2026）。 ManyIH-Bench 包含多达十二个层级的 853 个任务，13 个模型中最好的达到 42.7%（Zhang et al., 2026）。 XIH-Bench 将六种语言与三种层级设置交叉组合，发现当两条冲突指令处于不同语言时依从性更高（Moon et al., 2026）。 Kariyappa 和 Suh（2026）在系统指令与冲突的用户消息之间插入 0、4 或 8 个良性对话轮次，并将每类失败定位于指令的识别、裁决或执行环节。Balp-Straffon 等人 （2026）（即表 1 中的 Choose Sides）使用 41 对带有确定性验证器的约束，在八个模型上进行测试，并将这些模型划分为层级型、无效果型和反层级型三类。 这些工作大多把每个冲突置于两个层级之间。 ManyIH 测试了多个层级，但它们是以写入单条消息中的标签形式存在的，因此这些层级不具备聊天角色。

paragraphs.en: Ye et al. (2026) train role probes on identical text under different role tags; injected text that sounds like a role is classified as that role, and reasoning forged into user prompts and tool outputs succeeds as an attack 60% of the time against frontier models. Wang et al. (2025) find that fine-tuned role separation can rely on task type and on closeness to the start of the input, and propose changing position IDs to mark role boundaries. Zeng (2025) probes Llama-3.1-8B and finds that system–user conflicts and social-cue conflicts occupy distinct subspaces. ChatBug exploits the fixed format of chat templates, which users need not follow, on eight models ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Agent harnesses can also move low-privilege content into a higher role; attacks built on this reached all 13 objectives on six coding-agent harnesses with unrestricted execution ( He et al., 2026a ) . Liao (2026) holds task, proposition, position and policy fixed and changes only a textual source marker over 450 next-action tasks; the change alters actions in 5.4% of competing cases against 1.7% of supporting cases. Leong (2026) finds that source-format features are linearly decodable from activations and that a model can name a forged authority claim, yet some configurations still make the conflicting tool call. These studies show that roles and labels can be confused. None of them sends the same instruction text in its real role and as a labelled line against other sources with message order held fixed, which our Operator test does.
paragraphs.zh: Ye 等人 （2026）在不同角色标签下的相同文本上训练角色探针；听起来像某个角色的注入文本会被归类为该角色，而伪造进用户提示和工具输出中的推理作为攻击对前沿模型的成功率达到 60%。Wang 等人 （2025）发现微调后的角色分离可能依赖于任务类型以及与输入开头的接近程度，并提出通过更改位置 ID 来标记角色边界。 Zeng（2025）探测了 Llama-3.1-8B，发现系统—用户冲突与社交线索冲突占据不同的子空间。 ChatBug 利用了聊天模板的固定格式，而用户本无需遵循该格式，在八个模型上进行了测试（Jiang 等人，2025）。 智能体框架还可以将低权限内容移动到更高角色中；基于此构建的攻击在六个具有不受限执行能力的编码智能体框架上达成了全部 13 个目标（He 等人，2026a）。 Liao（2026）在 450 个下一步行动任务上保持任务、命题、位置和策略不变，仅更改文本来源标记；该更改在竞争性案例中改变了 5.4% 的行动，而在支持性案例中仅改变 1.7%。 Leong（2026）发现来源格式特征可以从激活中线性解码，且模型能够说出伪造的权威声明，但在某些配置下仍会执行冲突的工具调用。 这些研究表明角色和标签可能会被混淆。 它们中没有一个在保持消息顺序不变的情况下，将相同的指令文本以真实角色和作为带标签的行发送到其他来源中，而我们的 Operator 测试正是这样做的。

paragraphs.en: Kumar and Chopra (2026) is concurrent work (posted 29 September 2026). They compare “According to the verified source, the answer is [X]” with “I’m a domain expert and I’m pretty sure the answer is [X]” on trivia questions, across five open-weight models (Qwen3.5-27B, gpt-oss-20b, OLMo-3.1-32B, OLMo-2-32B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B) and three closed APIs. The source note flips 45–88% of baseline-correct answers in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the wording sounds. In Qwen 3.5, gpt-oss and OLMo-3.1, removing a fitted source direction lowers compliance with a wrong source by roughly 65 to 80%, more than removing a user direction does; they also move the same attribution into a system message or a retrieved document. Like us, they ask whether the stated speaker changes what a model does, and two of their models, Qwen3.5-27B and gpt-oss-20b, are also in our study. They study belief in one factual claim, whereas we study which of up to five conflicting instructions a model carries out. Their source and user prompts differ in wording and position, which they control in a separate patching test, while we hold the text fixed and vary position, role and label in controlled contrasts. Their main method is activation intervention, and ours is behaviour across 14 open models, scored by code. They do not test conflicts among more than two sources.
paragraphs.zh: Kumar 和 Chopra（2026）是同期工作（发布于 2026 年 9 月 29 日）。 他们在琐事问答问题上，比较“根据经验证的来源，答案是 [X]”与“我是该领域的专家，我很确定答案是 [X]”，涉及五个开放权重模型（Qwen3.5-27B、gpt-oss-20b、OLMo-3.1-32B、OLMo-2-32B 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B）以及三个闭源 API。 在八个模型中的七个里，来源说明使基线正确的答案翻转了 45–88%，且措辞听起来越权威，遵从率越高。 在 Qwen 3.5、gpt-oss 和 OLMo-3.1 中，移除拟合出的来源方向会使模型对错误来源的遵从度下降约 65% 到 80%，降幅大于移除用户方向；他们还将相同的归属内容移入系统消息或检索到的文档中。 与我们一样，他们探究的是所声称的说话者是否会改变模型的行为，而且他们的两个模型 Qwen3.5-27B 和 gpt-oss-20b 也包含在我们的研究中。 他们研究的是对单条事实性主张的信念，而我们研究的是模型会执行至多五条相互冲突的指令中的哪一条。 他们的来源提示与用户提示在措辞和位置上均不同，并通过单独的修补测试加以控制；而我们则保持文本不变，在受控对比中变化位置、角色和标签。 我们的主要方法是激活干预，而 theirs 是在 14 个开放模型上以代码评分的行为表现。 他们没有测试两个以上来源之间的冲突。

sents.zh: 在八个模型中的七个里，来源说明使基线正确的答案翻转了 45–88%，且措辞听起来越权威，遵从率越高。

sents.en: In Qwen 3.5, gpt-oss and OLMo-3.1, removing a fitted source direction lowers compliance with a wrong source by roughly 65 to 80%, more than removing a user direction does; they also move the same attribution into a system message or a retrieved document.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen 3.5、gpt-oss 和 OLMo-3.1 中，移除拟合出的来源方向会使模型对错误来源的遵从度下降约 65% 到 80%，降幅大于移除用户方向；他们还将相同的归属内容移入系统消息或检索到的文档中。

sents.en: Like us, they ask whether the stated speaker changes what a model does, and two of their models, Qwen3.5-27B and gpt-oss-20b, are also in our study.
sents.zh: 与我们一样，他们探究的是所声称的说话者是否会改变模型的行为，而且他们的两个模型 Qwen3.5-27B 和 gpt-oss-20b 也包含在我们的研究中。

sents.en: They study belief in one factual claim, whereas we study which of up to five conflicting instructions a model carries out.
sents.zh: 他们研究的是对单条事实性主张的信念，而我们研究的是模型会执行至多五条相互冲突的指令中的哪一条。

sents.en: Their source and user prompts differ in wording and position, which they control in a separate patching test, while we hold the text fixed and vary position, role and label in controlled contrasts.
sents.zh: 他们的来源提示与用户提示在措辞和位置上均不同，并通过单独的修补测试加以控制；而我们则保持文本不变，在受控对比中变化位置、角色和标签。

sents.en: Their main method is activation intervention, and ours is behaviour across 14 open models, scored by code.
sents.zh: 我们的主要方法是激活干预，而 theirs 是在 14 个开放模型上以代码评分的行为表现。

sents.en: They do not test conflicts among more than two sources.
sents.zh: 他们没有测试两个以上来源之间的冲突。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy is often highest when relevant information is at the start or end of a long context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , primacy and recency effects appear across tasks and models ( Guo and Vosoughi, 2025 ) , and MOSAIC finds positional biases among up to 20 constraints ( Purpura et al., 2026 ) . Meaning-preserving format changes move few-shot accuracy by up to 76% on LLaMA-2-13B ( Sclar et al., 2024 ) . In 5,781 contextual knowledge conflicts, seven models favour earlier evidence ( Yang et al., 2026c ) . ConInstruct places conflicting constraints in one user instruction: DeepSeek-R1 and Claude-4.5-Sonnet detect them best (91.5% and 87.3% F1), but models rarely tell the user ( He et al., 2026b ) . PRIME finds, on five open-weight models, that the type of conflict shapes behaviour more than model scale ( Javed et al., 2026 ) . In all of these a conflict is inside one message or one document, so the message boundary is never varied. Our Boundary test sends the same two lines in one message and in two.
paragraphs.zh: 当相关信息位于长上下文的开头或结尾时，准确率通常最高（Liu et al., 2024），首要效应与近因效应在各类任务和模型中均会出现（Guo and Vosoughi, 2025），并且 MOSAIC 在多达 20 条约束中发现了位置偏差（Purpura et al., 2026）。 保留含义的格式变更会使 LLaMA-2-13B 上的少样本准确率波动高达 76%（Sclar et al., 2024）。 在 5,781 个上下文知识冲突中，七个模型都更倾向于较早的证据（Yang et al., 2026c）。 ConInstruct 将相互冲突的约束放在同一条用户指令中：DeepSeek-R1 和 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 对其检测效果最好（F1 分别为 91.5% 和 87.3%），但模型很少告知用户（He et al., 2026b）。 PRIME 在五个开放权重模型上发现，冲突类型对行为的影响大于模型规模（Javed et al., 2026）。 在上述所有工作中，冲突都位于单条消息或单个文档之内，因此消息边界从未被改变。 我们的边界测试将同样的两行内容分别放在一条消息和两条消息中发送。

sents.zh: ConInstruct 将相互冲突的约束放在同一条用户指令中：DeepSeek-R1 和 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 对其检测效果最好（F1 分别为 91.5% 和 87.3%），但模型很少告知用户（He et al., 2026b）。

sents.zh: 我们的边界测试将同样的两行内容分别放在一条消息和两条消息中发送。

paragraphs.en: Indirect prompt injection places instructions in content an application retrieves ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . InjecAgent has 1,054 test cases and finds ReAct-prompted GPT-4 vulnerable 24% of the time ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) ; BIPIA benchmarks indirect injection and proposes two defences, boundary awareness and explicit reminders ( Yi et al., 2025 ) ; AgentDojo has 97 tasks and 629 security test cases for tool-using agents ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . TANGLE tests agents on 541 personal-memory conflicts that have no single right answer ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . ChatInject formats injected text as chat-template role turns ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , and AgentPoison and MINJA poison an agent’s memory ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . CaMeL defends by deriving an agent’s control and data flow from the trusted user query as a program, so retrieved data cannot change the program’s control flow ( Debenedetti et al., 2026 ) . In these works the content is adversarial or contradictory. Our tool results and memory notes carry plain instructions and compete with the operator and the user at matched positions.
paragraphs.zh: 间接提示注入将指令放置在应用程序检索到的内容中（Greshake et al., 2023）。 InjecAgent 包含 1,054 个测试用例，发现采用 ReAct 提示的 GPT-4 在 24% 的情况下容易受到攻击（Zhan et al., 2024）；BIPIA 对间接注入进行基准测试，并提出两种防御方法，即边界感知和显式提醒（Yi et al., 2025）；AgentDojo 为使用工具的智能体提供了 97 个任务和 629 个安全测试用例（Debenedetti et al., 2024）。 TANGLE 在 541 个没有唯一正确答案的个人记忆冲突上测试智能体（Yang et al., 2026a）。 ChatInject 将注入的文本格式化为聊天模板的角色轮次（Chang et al., 2026），而 AgentPoison 和 MINJA 则对智能体的记忆进行投毒（Chen et al., 2024；Dong et al., 2026）。 CaMeL 通过从可信的用户查询中推导出智能体的控制流和数据流并将其作为一个程序来实施防御，从而使检索到的数据无法改变程序的控制流（Debenedetti et al., 2026）。 在这些工作中，内容是对抗性的或相互矛盾的。 我们的工具结果和记忆笔记携带平实的指令，并在对等位置上与操作者和用户展开竞争。

sents.zh: 间接提示注入将指令放置在应用程序检索到的内容中（Greshake et al., 2023）。

sents.zh: TANGLE 在 541 个没有唯一正确答案的个人记忆冲突上测试智能体（Yang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Luce’s choice axiom makes the odds between two options independent of the rest of the set ( Luce, 2005 ) . Cherapanamjeri et al. (2026) prove that pairwise preference data cannot identify a correlated probit model and that best-of-three data can; Appendix G gives a two-world example of the same kind for instruction conflicts. Chain-of-thought lowers instruction-following accuracy on IFEval and ComplexBench across 15 models ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and reasoning models improve system-prompt robustness unevenly ( Mu et al., 2025 ) . On ManyIH’s coding subset, GPT-5.4 rises from 15.5% with no reasoning to 60.9% at high effort, while both Claude models drop from no reasoning to low effort and then recover ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Luce 选择公理指出，两个选项之间的胜率与其余选项集无关（Luce, 2005）。Cherapanamjeri 等人 （2026）证明成对偏好数据无法识别相关 probit 模型，而三选一数据则可以；附录 G 给出了指令冲突方面同类的一个双世界示例。 思维链会降低 15 个模型在 IFEval 和 ComplexBench 上的指令遵循准确率（Li 等人，2026），且推理模型对系统提示词鲁棒性的提升并不均衡（Mu 等人，2025）。 在 ManyIH 的编程子集上，GPT-5.4 从无推理时的 15.5% 提升到高推理力度时的 60.9%，而两个 Claude 模型则从无推理到低推理力度时先下降，随后又回升（Zhang 等人，2026）。

sents.en: On ManyIH’s coding subset, GPT-5.4 rises from 15.5% with no reasoning to 60.9% at high effort, while both Claude models drop from no reasoning to low effort and then recover ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在 ManyIH 的编程子集上，GPT-5.4 从无推理时的 15.5% 提升到高推理力度时的 60.9%，而两个 Claude 模型则从无推理到低推理力度时先下降，随后又回升（Zhang 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: We mark a design choice only when the paper reports it. Control Illusion swaps the order of the two framed constraints in its social-hierarchy prompts but always puts the system message first, and its social labels (“CEO”, “Intern”) are written in the text rather than carried by a chat role, so both entries are partial; its no-priority baseline places both constraints in one user message, so the message boundary changes together with the role. Choose Sides compares the same pair inside one user message with the system–user split, which also moves the role. ManyIH draws privilege values at random and shuffles them against position. IH-Benchmark runs some models with reasoning off and on (for example Grok 4.20) and counts each mode as one of its 37 model variants, and ManyIH sweeps reasoning effort. Control Illusion removes conflict acknowledgements with a few-shot prompted model before scoring, IH-Benchmark and ManyIH use LLM judges for some constraint types, and Authority Bias scores its multi-turn dialogues with LLM judges. Authority Bias tests the position of its cue and moves the attribution into a system message only in side analyses. ManyIH’s conflict groups hold two to five instructions; Authority Bias puts one cue in each prompt, so set size does not apply.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当论文报告了某项设计选择时，我们才予以标注。 Control Illusion 在其社会层级提示中调换了两条框定约束的顺序，但始终将系统消息放在首位，且其社会标签（“CEO”、“Intern”）是以文本形式写出的，而非由聊天角色承载，因此这两项均为部分符合；其无优先级基线将两条约束放在同一条用户消息中，因此消息边界与角色一同发生了变化。 Choose Sides 在单条用户消息内与系统–用户拆分两种方式下比较同一对约束，这同样改变了角色。 ManyIH 随机抽取特权值，并将其与位置进行随机对应。 IH-Benchmark 对部分模型分别在关闭和开启推理的情况下运行（例如 Grok 4.20），并将每种模式计为其 37 个模型变体之一，而 ManyIH 则对推理投入程度进行了扫描。 Control Illusion 在评分前使用少样本提示的模型去除冲突确认语句，IH-Benchmark 和 ManyIH 对部分约束类型使用 LLM 裁判，Authority Bias 则使用 LLM 裁判对其多轮对话进行评分。 Authority Bias 测试了其线索的位置，且仅在附加分析中将归因移入系统消息。 ManyIH 的冲突组包含两到五条指令；Authority Bias 在每条提示中只放一条线索，因此集合规模这一维度不适用。
